mission_1_1.taskContent:
[Order 231]
Client: Vannini
For next year's gunsmith qualification exam, just around the corner. Need to show her how to make a gun of her own.

Client comment: I hope I won't let you down for everything you've done for me, Magister.
mission_1_1.afterTaskContent:
In the evening, you feel a bottle of firearm cleaning solvent under the table. The liquid inside has long since dried up, but there is still the faint sweet scent of vanilla. You think back...

Vannini was still a child at the time, and she hadn't been at the workshop for very long. The Notarial Hall sent over her mother's patron firearm. She held onto that filthy gun, still covered in bloodstains... You didn't want to think too hard about where they came from.
So you brought her to the workroom, explaining to her how to clean a gun. You asked her if she needed help, but she said nothing. You wanted to stay and keep her company, but then you saw her lower her head.
You were at a loss, thinking she wanted to be by herself for a while. With a sigh, you turned and headed back upstairs. The moment you heard glass shattering, you hurried back downstairs. The workbench was completely covered in solvent, and all Vannini did was tremble as she stood in shock at the scene of the 'accident'.
You wanted to say something to console her, but it was clear that no matter what you said, she'd only reply with silence. She had lost her family and was suffering. You knew this much, and tried many times to find an inroad to her heart, but you never found the right place to start.

You relive the fatigue you felt at the time, ignoring the fact that the bottle had shattered long ago.

mission_1_2.taskContent:
[Order 231]
Client: Vannini
After some discussion, we decided to reference Vannini's mother's patron firearm in the construction of this one. But we've found keeping to this standard to have major flaws. Will need to make further adjustments.

Client comment: Thank you for looking after my mother's patron firearm, Magister.
mission_1_2.afterTaskContent:
In the middle of the night, you knock a few books off the bookshelf. They open as you pick them up, and a report greets you from among the pages. You are reminded of the day you brought Vannini to doctors all across the city.

[Medical Report]
Pagus Faber Central Hospital, Halo Surgery
Patient suffers from a speech impediment, speaking with only great difficulty and with severe lexical deficiency. Patient also shows mild difficulties in reading and writing. Diagnosis is psychogenic aphasia.
Aside from medication, considering the family's particular circumstances, weekly empathy contact sessions at this hospital have been suggested.

You couldn't rely on empathy to read the girl's mind, so at the doctor's suggestion, you bought Little Halo, Little Heart, a series of books about Sankta child psychology. You memorized every passage in those books, but when you saw her stuttering in front of you, the grim reality set in. Every sentence of these lousy books was based on a central premise: both you and your child have big, bright halos on your heads.
But you don't have one—not then, not now. What a shame. Those books were useless to you.

You relive the anxiety and anger you felt at the time, ignoring the fact that you tore these books to shreds in a fit of rage long ago.

mission_1_3.taskContent:
[Order 231]
Client: Vannini
Gun's nearly finished. The slow firing rate issue has been addressed. Just needs a lick of paint and decoration.

Client comment: I'd like you to finish the decorations on the gun, Magister. Ever since I was little, I've always thought every gift you gave me was beautiful.
mission_1_3.afterTaskContent:
Late at night, you notice a feather cape on the sofa. You pick it up and find the label, and are reminded of a winter several years ago.

Made from: 100% Paganini feathers
Dry clean only
Do not wash at over 30 degrees
Hang-dry
Iron at low temperature
Do not bleach
—Laundry tag

Whenever Vannini felt cold, she would bury herself in your thick feathers, only sticking her face out once she was nearly out of breath.
Every molting season, you would gather a big sack's worth of feathers and pick out the most beautiful and lustrous ones to make a cape. It took you a good few years to do it, since your feathers were always rather dull and drab from a lack of rest. Once she got the cape, Vannini took about half a day to express her gratitude. It was an incredibly long speech, all in all, but you couldn't have asked for better payment.
You held back tears as you gazed at her. You didn't speak, and she didn't either, electing instead to nervously twiddle her thumbs.

You relive the joy and happiness you felt at the time, forgetting about the time you threw your oil-stained work clothes in the filthy laundry basket labeled 'Dry clean only'. The cape was stained in iridescent oil long ago.
mission_1_3.taskDesc: Clear MT-7 with a 3-star rating, and awaken at least 5 Shrine Marksman Cosplayers on Dream Tiles

mission_2_1.taskContent:
[Order 172]
Client: Fiammetta
Small firearm, easy to carry while doing fieldwork, requires a full set of attachments, right-handed.

Client comment: Senior Paganini, this gun is a gift for a friend's birthday. Money isn't an issue; I just hope you can get it done before December.
mission_2_1.afterTaskContent:
In the evening, you find a large stack of documents in the filing cabinet, hidden away for years, their pages long yellowed. You think back to all those years ago, to the first time St. Theodore's Comprehensive School invited you to make patron firearms for their students.

First Semester Comprehensive Shooting Course Rankings, Year ■■■
1st: Fiammetta
2nd: Lemuen
3rd: Mostima
4th: Caelia
......
Second Semester Comprehensive Shooting Course Rankings, Year ■■■
1st: Lemuen
2nd: Fiammetta
3rd: Mostima
4th: Caelia
......
First Semester Comprehensive Shooting Course Rankings, Year ■■■
1st: Fiammetta
2nd: Lemuen
3rd: Mostima
4th: Caelia
......

Class of ■■■ Graduates, Patron Firearm Manufacture List
1. Lemuen
2. Mostima
3. Caelia
......
You flipped through the files, one after the other, and blurted out to the teacher that the child named Fiammetta wasn't on the list. You were informed she was a Liberi. The regret clouding the teacher's eyes left you at a loss.

You feel frustrated, ignoring the fact that you never brought that list back to your workshop after perusing it.
mission_2_1.taskDesc: Clear MT-4 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Sniper Operator at least 1 time

mission_2_2.taskContent:
[Order 172]
Client: Fiammetta
Client's friend was very satisfied after seeing the plans. The remaining details of manufacture can be left to the gunsmith's discretion.

Client comment: I suppose that's how geniuses think, Senior Paganini.
mission_2_2.afterTaskContent:
At night, you find a piece of cake in the refrigerator. After sating your hunger, you think back to how astonished you were the first time you had it.

Every time they were done with a mission, that one squad would always come to your workshop for weapon maintenance, bringing with them some of that cake you adored.
The Sanktas treated their patron firearms like their babies, hoping you would clean them with utmost gentleness. The Liberi, on the other hand, would always ask you questions with a straight face:
'Can you make the grenade launcher fire further?
'Can you improve the rifling?
'Changing out the attachments is a pain in the ass... Anything you can do to fix it?'
At least, until you told her you could, but first, she had to be okay with swapping out a transmitter, since the current one was barely more than a worn-out lump of iron.
As straight-faced as ever, she said:
'Then swap it already.'
You sighed with relief that this wasn't a patron firearm. If it were, its owner would have been going mad with worry over the damage.
She turned back to her friends, one of them sobbing her eyes out over having to change her gun's sights. Soon after, the corners of the Liberi's mouth turned upwards, and she said rather happily:
'Good thing I don't have a guardian gun.'

You are enraptured by the taste, forgetting that these raisin cakes were never actually that tasty, since there were always pranksters embedding odd-tasting candy in them.

mission_2_3.taskContent:
[Order 172]
Client: Fiammetta
Null

Client comment: I'm sorry, Senior Paganini. Some stuff happened recently, and my friend, she... she won't be needing that gun anymore. I'll still pay you the rest of your fee. As for the gun, can I leave it in your care for now?
mission_2_3.afterTaskContent:
Late at night, you raise your head while in the middle of work to check the time. It's nearly midnight. You remember the last time Seniora Fiammetta came to your workshop. It was rather late at night too.

She was in a gloomy mood as she told you the owner of the 'Gun of the Year' was already far from Laterano, and that before she left, all she did was give Fiammetta a pocket watch, telling her to look after it.
She rubbed her forehead as she grumbled:
'They all got over it, but I just can't... I'm always one step behind them, I get it!
'Just like this watch... That woman went and gave me a watch that can't even keep time.'
You handed her a cup of wine, took the pocket watch she handed to you, and got its mechanism working again, its hands leaping back to life. You suddenly realized why Mostima left her pocket watch with her.
'I think...' You chose your words carefully as you tried to console her.
'Look at the watch, Seniora Fiammetta. The second and minute hands are both swift, but while the hour hand may lag behind them, at midnight the three will always reunite, and a new day will dawn.
'These three hands, they come together to form this watch.'
She sighed, broke out into a smile, then left.

You continue on with your work, so busy you forgot that Fiammetta never came by that day.
mission_2_3.taskDesc: Clear MT-8 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Operators on Dream Tiles at least 2 times

mission_3_1.taskContent:
[Order 0]
Client: Patrizion
Large rotary machine gun used by gun-knights. The stuff left behind by the old masters can use a lot of improvement. I'll put my back into it. I want to give Patrizion the machine gun with the most firepower in all of Laterano when he becomes a gun-knight.

Client comment: I'm truly honored to be one of your clients, my friend.
mission_3_1.afterTaskContent:
In the evening, you receive a greeting from an old friend. As you think back to the little moments when you were friends, your mind is left in disarray.

The silver papal gun-knight medal, established by then-Pope Ludovico IV on February the 14th of 1029, was made to honor trainee knights who displayed especially outstanding skill, allowing them to skip the final examinations and formally join the gun-knights early. The youngest of these recipients, Patrizion, was only twenty-six years of age.

At the award ceremony, you were part of the crowd. You saw the pope himself pin the medal onto Patrizion. Your younger cousin Gia was holding your hand tightly, transmitting both her excitement and nervousness to you.
After paying his respects to the pope, he scanned the crowd anxiously. You and Gia held your arms up high, shouting as much as you could. The moment he saw the two of you, he broke out into a smile.
You looked at him as he looked back, your heart full of pride. The two of you had a pact. If he managed to get this medal, then you'd entrust that giant gun you made recently to him. You had voiced your doubts, but in your heart, you knew there was nobody else worthy to wield your 'masterpiece' aside from that smiling, splendid little bastard.

You don't answer his message, throwing your communicator aside in irritation, completely forgetting that, at the time, it wasn't you who locked eyes with him, but Gia.

mission_3_2.taskContent:
[Order 0]
Client: Patrizion
Perhaps... the original design could be split into two parts that can be used independently.

Client comment: I showed your design to my commanding officer. You'll have to thank me later, since you might be getting new work right away.
mission_3_2.afterTaskContent:
At night, you receive a necklace from Columbia in the mail. It looks very familiar, and you can't help but wonder where you've seen it before.

...Patri, Avia's leaving you this necklace. If you ever find the right girl one day, give it to her to wear, then bring her to my grave for me to have a look. July would be best. The jasmines will be in bloom.
—The portion of Patrizion's grandmother's will concerning him

That day, you saw Patrizion putting that necklace around Gia's neck as she looked down bashfully.
Their wedding was to be in July, and you were their best man, organizing the entire wedding in the lovebirds' place. When the two of them confessed their relationship to you, at first you were angry at them for hiding it from you, but that anger quickly turned to joy. You had long hoped he would become a part of your family. After all, ever since his grandmother passed, he was the only one left in his.

The necklace comes with news of Gia's death. You endure the grief, forgetting how on that day, you weren't actually that happy. Gia had whispered to you about how her knee was always aching lately.
mission_3_2.taskDesc: Clear MT-7 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Specialist Operator at least 1 time

mission_3_3.taskContent:
[Order 0]
Client: Patrizion
Gave it a coat of bright paint, needs to match the gun-knight armor.

Client comment: This is a masterpiece, my friend. I can't stop thinking about heading off on my next mission when I hold it.
mission_3_3.afterTaskContent:
Late at night, you take out a letter from inside the safe. A letter Gia entrusted you with to give Patrizion. You never did. You think back.

[Mission Notice]
Date of mission: 07/21
Mission objective: Exiling an Oripathy patient from the Holy City
Executor: Patrizion

From June to July, you looked for Patrizion countless times, hoping there could be some room for negotiation. Even if Gia had to stay at a convent outside the Holy City, it would be fine, but he was silent, spitting out only a single sentence after a long while:
'The Law... cannot be violated.'
You gave Gia a hug before sending her off to the waiting convoy outside the Holy City. It was a raging-hot July, but her hands were ice-cold. Patrizion stood by the convoy, carrying his gun, not saying a word. He glanced incessantly at you and Gia, but he never dared to look the two of you in the face.

You put the letter and the necklace back into the safe, deleting Patrizion's number as you do so. Grief made you forget that you never had his number.
mission_3_3.taskDesc: Clear MT-9 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Defender Operator at least 1 time

mission_4_1.taskContent:
[Order 208]
Client: Idida
Anything is fine.

Client comment: We don't have too many requests for this guardian gun, Senior Paganini. Our little Idida already has her own guardian toothbrush, after all. That should be fine, right?
mission_4_1.afterTaskContent:
In the depths of the fridge there is always a carton of your sinful pleasure hidden away: ice cream. In the early morning, you dig out a big scoop, but just as you are about to bring it to your beak, there is a knock at the door.

You open the door to see Idida, the neighbors' young daughter, holding a thick stack of leaflets.
With a resigned sigh, you say: 'You know it's not even five in the morning yet, right, kid?'
The girl simply bats her eyelashes before letting out a sly smile: 'But you're a nocturnal Liberi, right?' You sigh and take a leaflet, the giant cautionary slogan domineering your view and reminding you to avoid harmful sugar.
You are reminded of the pamphlets stuffing your mailbox, inviting you to take part in neighborhood meetings every week, where discussions on how to expel dessert shops from the neighborhood—no, all of Laterano—take place. You suddenly realize why this house was so cheap. No ordinary Lateran could tolerate living next to these insane dentists who wouldn't stop talking about fluoridated toothpaste.
'Want something to eat before you go, Idida?'
'Thanks, but that's not going to work on me! I won't be tempted by the evil desserts in your fridge!'
'That's not it, Idida. I just thought you still don't fully understand your enemy.'
You wink as you stuff a carton of ice cream into her hands.
mission_4_1.taskDesc: Clear MT-4 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Operators on Dream Tiles at least 2 times

mission_4_2.taskContent:
[Order 208]
Client: Idida
Needs a coat of mint paint, a shade that makes people think of extra-strong toothpaste.

Client comment: You've avoided going to neighborhood meetings many times now, Senior Paganini. We hope you can attend the next one and fulfill your duty as a member of this community. As you have dismantled your mailbox, this is the only way we can contact you.
mission_4_2.afterTaskContent:
It's now midnight, and you're still enjoying your sinful ice cream without a care in the land. Suddenly, a wave of knocking hammers at your door. You open it.

You see Idida, her face covered in tears. Her mouth opens wide due to her weeping, and you notice that where her two incisors should be, there are only gaps.
'I'm being punished, all because of your wicked ice cream! My teeth fell out!'
You sigh and hand her some tissues as you try to console her.
'No, you're just at that age when you get new teeth, Idida.'
'Teeth falling out is a punishment! The original sin of the Sankta is loving desserts!'
No matter what you say, she does not stop wailing. Her tears do not stop either, as if her eyes were broken faucets. It is not long before the waste basket is full of soggy tissues.
'What's it gonna take for you to stop crying?'
'*sniff* I don't know either... Right now, it's just my teeth falling out, but what if my halo gets cavities next? There's nothing you can do to make me feel better, just give up.'
'I've got a new flavor of ice cream in my fridge.'
'......'
'Want some?'
'...Yeah.'
'If you have some, will you stop crying?'
The girl sobs as she opens the carton of ice cream. In your heart, you smirk. What Sankta could resist the allure of sweet ice cream? No one, that's who.
'All your teeth will fall out eventually, you know.'
'That's not going to work on me. I don't have teeth—I grind up my food with gastroliths.'
mission_4_2.taskDesc: Clear MT-8 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Guard Operator at least 1 time

mission_4_3.taskContent:
[Order 802]
Client: Paganini
Twelve cartons of sugar-free ice cream, a mix of flavors, express delivery.

Client comment: Remember to avoid Vannini when you deliver it. I haven't been keeping my weight in check lately, and she's got her eye on me.
mission_4_3.afterTaskContent:
Late at night, you open the miniature fridge under your bed, only to discover you've already eaten all your ice cream. All that is left is a lonely salad. You sigh and open it up, but then a familiar chain of knocks rap against your door.

You open the door, but rather than who you expected, it is your neighbor holding a thick stack of leaflets while inviting you to participate in next week's neighborhood meeting.
You take a leaflet, noting that it is no longer about how to stop desserts from entering the neighborhood, but rather a joint discussion on how to help Idida spread the good word of sugar-free ice cream across all of Laterano.
Your neighbor proudly chats with you about the girl in question.
'Say, thanks to my girl inventing sugar-free ice cream, Laterano will finally receive salvation.
To whoever gave her this revelation, may fluoridated toothpaste bless you!'
You give an embarrassed smile, saying you'll definitely attend if you have the time.
After sending off your neighbor, you return to your desk and prepare to eat your dinner, but once more you are rudely interrupted by more knocking on your door.
You open the door to see Idida smiling a gap-toothed smile.
'As the one who gave me the revelation of sugar-free ice cream, would you like to make an investment?'
'Absolutely not, little girl.'
'Then would you like to try some?'
You note that the leafy greens in the carton have no vinaigrette on them.
'...Yeah.'
mission_4_3.taskDesc: Clear MT-9 with a 3-star rating, and awaken at least 1 Shrine Nurturer Cosplayer on a Dream Tile

personItem_61n3.gunContent: The first firearm Vannini made as an apprentice. Completed under the guidance of her magister Paganini, its manufacture makes it clear it was created by a novice, but its various innovations are proof enough of her talent as a gunsmith.

personItem_pandm.gunContent: Mostima's second gun, commissioned by her friend Fiammetta as a birthday gift. Very expensive, with quality to match. Unanimously praised by the gunsmiths of Via Borgos, and honored with that year's 'Gun of the Year' award.

personItem_patrizion.gunContent: The gun that made Paganini famous, and Patrizion's first heavy firearm after becoming a gun-knight. Artisanal machining and military standardization join together to form a masterpiece.

personItem_61n16.gunContent: The first batch of sugar-free ice cream Idida made. Paganini at the gunsmithy is her only regular customer. Even with her door-to-door sales technique, most Laterans still see it as heresy.

policeman.description: Every little detail causes his eyes to light up—except for the bill.

citizen_beginner.name: Passerby
citizen_beginner.description: A diligent slacker who is always on the lookout for the latest gossip. Has average starting stats.

friendly.name: Friendly
friendly.description: These customers are friendly and <color=#0d99b2>unlikely</color> to be irritated.

sly.name: Cunning
sly.description: These customers are curious about the latest info, but very cautious. <color=#0d99b2>Very high</color> starting Interest, <color=#ea3b47>low</color> starting Trust and Deposit.

passionate.name: Passionate
passionate.description: These customers are passionate about people and things. <color=#0d99b2>High</color> starting Interest and Deposit.

picky.name: Picky
picky.description: These customers have a considerable budget, but they are very picky about information. <color=#0d99b2>High</color> Deposit and <color=#0d99b2>unlikely</color> to become irritated, but <color=#ea3b47>low</color> starting Interest.

busy.name: Busy
busy.description: These customers are busy, but are happy to spend money to save time. <color=#0d99b2>Very high</color> Deposit, but <color=#ea3b47>easily</color> irritated.

shy.name: Shy
shy.description: These customers are not particularly talkative; simply coming into the shop seems to take considerable effort. <color=#0d99b2>High</color> Deposit and starting Interest, but <color=#ea3b47>easily</color> irritated.

calm.name: Calm
calm.description: These customers are always calm and at ease in a conversation. <color=#0d99b2>Unlikely</color> to become irritated, but <color=#ea3b47>low</color> Deposit, starting Interest and starting Trust.

special.name: Special Customer
special.description: A rare customer with little information available. Perhaps they will cause some changes in the shop furnishing?

customerDialogMap.yakuza_entrance_01: Is this the place? What is it, karaoke? A manga cafe? I can't tell what my bro drew on this piece of paper...
customerDialogMap.yakuza_entrance_02: ...This clearly isn't a shop for ordinary people. But I'm no ordinary person.
customerDialogMap.yakuza_highPatience_01: You really do know your stuff, do you? People don't normally know these things without having witnessed them first-hand.
customerDialogMap.yakuza_highPatience_02: There aren't many people with your kind of discretion these days. You've made me want to introduce myself.
customerDialogMap.yakuza_highPatience_03: What's the saying? 'The bystander sees clearly.' That introvert brother of mine should come and have a chat with you.
customerDialogMap.yakuza_LowPatience_01: Do I look like I have a lot of time? Get to the point, or stop advertising to my bros.
customerDialogMap.yakuza_LowPatience_02: Who do you think I am? You've got a ways to go before you can try to sweet-talk me. Don't play any games with me if you still want to open shop tomorrow.
customerDialogMap.yakuza_LowPatience_03: Did you do that on purpose? Get up, don't block the phone. Who were you calling? Who ordered you to stall for time?
customerDialogMap.yakuza_normalDeal_02: You wanna live the rest of your life with just one eye? What's that? You already have a fake eye? I don't care, I'm tearing it out anyway!

customerDialogMap.citizen_entrance_01: Is this that legendary shop? It looks pretty ordinary... Anything interesting lately?
customerDialogMap.citizen_entrance_02: I snuck out to slack off. You got anything relaxing here?
customerDialogMap.citizen_highPatience_01: The real stuff, you say? Don't worry, my lips are sealed. Mind if I took notes? I'll use my terminal.
customerDialogMap.citizen_highPatience_02: You got a podcast? I'll follow if you start one! You're always so interesting.
customerDialogMap.citizen_highPatience_03: Can I get a drink refill? Sorry, as soon as I sit down here I lose track of time. Haven't felt like this in ages.
customerDialogMap.citizen_LowPatience_01: Can we get straight to the point? I have to go to work soon.
customerDialogMap.citizen_LowPatience_02: The wi-fi here's pretty slow. I'm bored. Do you sell anything else here, other than the chance to chat with you?
customerDialogMap.citizen_LowPatience_03: I don't like to rush people, but you talk like my neighbor. You don't have to start everything from how Amanohara-Oomikami cleaved open Magatsu, you know.
customerDialogMap.citizen_normalDeal_01: I still have to help the neighbor's kid with his math homework, and listening to you talk is reminding me of math. It's giving me a headache.
customerDialogMap.citizen_normalDeal_02: I was tired enough already, and I'm not sure I'll have the strength to get home after listening to you talk. I'm taking a detour next time.

customerDialogMap.punk_entrance_01: Anything exciting going on? Come on, you can tell me. What else are neighbors for?
customerDialogMap.punk_entrance_02: You know anything about that patrol car on the street one block away? A whole crowd gathered to watch.
customerDialogMap.punk_highPatience_01: You know that?! Are you a gangster too? Well, come find me at the park if you ever need anything.
customerDialogMap.punk_highPatience_02: You talk just like my aniki. Come to think of it, you look a bit like my aniki too...
customerDialogMap.punk_highPatience_03: I wish the cops were more like you. They tried to take me in just 'cause they didn't like the way I looked.
customerDialogMap.punk_LowPatience_01: What d'ya mean? Don't use big words, I never finished middle school.
customerDialogMap.punk_LowPatience_02: Are you trying me? My boss said folks like you like to trick people into making mistakes. You pickin' a fight or somethin'?
customerDialogMap.punk_LowPatience_03: Why you say that? You lookin' down on me or somethin'? I'll tear down your door if you don't say somethin' useful.
customerDialogMap.punk_normalDeal_01: I'm outta here! I don't even stop for a red light, you think I'd listen to your crap?
customerDialogMap.punk_normalDeal_02: You're not gonna talk normally, are you? Listen, *long string of Higashinese expletives*...
customerDialogMap.fans_entrance_01: Is it true that you get a lot of celebs here? Do you have any photos?
customerDialogMap.fans_entrance_02: Do you have the private schedules of celebs here? No, I won't take any photos, I just wanted to take a look!
customerDialogMap.fans_highPatience_01: I knew I came to the right person! That's what Hoshigawa Weekly said, just as I predicted!
customerDialogMap.fans_highPatience_02: He really goes to that dessert shop every MWF? Then eats it quietly in the park? Thank you!
customerDialogMap.fans_highPatience_03: You're a diehard fan too, aren't you? Who's your oshi? Group or solo? Are we kindred spirits?
customerDialogMap.fans_LowPatience_01: Come on, this is old news, even the repost of the repost is old stuff. And you shouldn't put these defamatory photos out there.
customerDialogMap.fans_LowPatience_02: I'm not here to listen to gossip. Schedules, I want schedules! It's not like someone so clean would have any juicy gossip anyway.
customerDialogMap.fans_LowPatience_03: You're not an anti, are you? Where do you get your news? Don't tell me it's all message board rumors?
customerDialogMap.fans_normalDeal_01: I knew it was fake that he comes here! What a waste of time.
customerDialogMap.fans_normalDeal_02: What the hell are you talking about? This is pure slander! I'll inform the talent agency. You can expect a lawsuit!

customerDialogMap.businessmen_entrance_01: I hear that this is the most well-connected place in Mitsukue? Let's get straight to the point. I've got the money. You understand, don't you?
customerDialogMap.businessmen_entrance_02: The soundproofing here is good. Visibility isn't great, but the location has potential, and there's plenty of traffic. Not bad...
customerDialogMap.businessmen_highPatience_01: Good. Very logical. I like efficiency, and I like that you understand the market.
customerDialogMap.businessmen_highPatience_02: You come as advertised. Do you do subscription deals? All I want is some 'insider info'. We can talk about the fee.
customerDialogMap.businessmen_highPatience_03: Not many places are so serious about their content these days. Any interest in opening a branch?
customerDialogMap.businessmen_LowPatience_01: A little too repetitive. You're not giving me junk data, are you?
customerDialogMap.businessmen_LowPatience_02: You're lacking in a modelable sense of order. I suggest you take a course or two in business school.
customerDialogMap.businessmen_LowPatience_03: I don't need tabloid-grade junk. Young people might fall for it, but I won't.
customerDialogMap.businessmen_normalDeal_01: Do you have any idea how much my time's worth? I'm going to the authorities! Scammers like you ought to be put out of business!
customerDialogMap.businessmen_normalDeal_02: How unfortunate. You've lost an important client today.
customerDialogMap.hoshiguma_entrance_01: Got something that I need your help with, Moriuchi-san. Same deal as usual. You up for it?
customerDialogMap.hoshiguma_highPatience_01: Yes, there are a lot of things that can be dealt with using a fist or a knife. But it's nice to have alternatives.
customerDialogMap.hoshiguma_highPatience_02: Got any booze? Went to a few shops and none of them would sell to me. I'll just take a seat for a while. Hope I'm not bothering you.
customerDialogMap.hoshiguma_lowPatience_01: You're starting to go around in circles. Stop making a kaidan out of everything, I can tell when you're stalling for time.
customerDialogMap.hoshiguma_lowPatience_02: Sorry, but I don't have time for reminiscing. And stop refilling my cup, we've got serious matters to talk about.
customerDialogMap.hoshiguma_normalDeal_01: We've known each other for quite a while, Moriuchi-san. Why play games like this with me? I'll see you around.
customerDialogMap.haruka_entrance_01: A-Are you sure the paparazzi won't find me here, Moriuchi-san?
customerDialogMap.haruka_highPatience_01: I wish I could turn those words into lyrics. It'd be a lot more moving than generic stuff like 'always shining'.
customerDialogMap.haruka_highPatience_02: My engagement this evening just got canceled. Should we go get some oden? What? You can make oden here?
customerDialogMap.haruka_lowPatience_01: P-Please, stop telling horror stories, you're making my stomach hurt...
customerDialogMap.haruka_lowPatience_02: Why hasn't Mio-san called me? She said she'd be here in five minutes...
customerDialogMap.haruka_normalDeal_01: P-Please, stop talking about agencies or schedules or fans! I just want to be nameless right now... I've got to go! *Sob*
customerDialogMap.yakuzaheiress_entrance_01: What, am I not welcome here?
customerDialogMap.yakuzaheiress_highPatience_01: ...No, I was looking for someone. But it's alright. Continue.
customerDialogMap.yakuzaheiress_highPatience_02: And then? ...No? I'm not in a hurry. Are you?
customerDialogMap.yakuzaheiress_lowPatience_01: No euphemisms. I'm used to hearing keywords. I remember every time you dodged around the point.
customerDialogMap.yakuzaheiress_lowPatience_02: Were you under the impression that we were friends? Do not try to infer my emotions.
customerDialogMap.policeman_entrance_01: No need to be nervous. There's just something I wanted to know. You say you don't know? Maybe a little chat will change that.
customerDialogMap.policeman_highPatience_01: You're more of a traditionalist than you look.
customerDialogMap.policeman_highPatience_02: Keep going. Plenty of empty space in my notebook. The more you say, the easier it is for me to write my report.
customerDialogMap.policeman_lowPatience_01: Quit with this 'someone said' stuff. Make it clear who's saying what.
customerDialogMap.policeman_lowPatience_02: Don't play the fool with me. I've heard more lies than you've heard truths.
customerDialogMap.policeman_normalDeal_01: You're not an information dealer, you're a novelist. It'd be less of a waste of time listening to my colleagues spin tall tales back at the station.

customerDialogMap.citizen_beginner_normalDeal_02: I was tired enough already, and I'm not sure I'll have the strength to get home after listening to you talk. I'm taking a detour next time.

keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueA_01: Now, why would I lie to you? The police would be after me if this was fake. Why don't you hear me out and decide whether it's worth it or not?
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueA_02: I tell you, all the tabloids in Mitsukue would be hot on my heels if I let this slip, but information should end up in the hands of the right people, and I've finally found the right person to talk to.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueA_03: I had a feeling that you'd come, so I compiled this story based on intel that I obtained from three different sources...
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueB_01: I didn't make this up! I heard it straight from his mouth, you know, that mogul by the name of Mifune, as we drank together. Mifune-sama. Need I say any more?
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueB_02: Now, now, surely you're joking. I have the first-hand testimony as well as physical evidence, complete with tea stain, signature, and date. I wouldn't have gotten this stuff if it was fake, would I?
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueB_03: Now, don't laugh at me... I know it sounds outlandish, but you might find my name at the end of the credits if this ever gets turned into a drama. After all, something that's 'based on true events' needs an original to reference.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueC_01: Smooth and slick is outside my wheelhouse. All I can do is tell what I know to people willing to listen. You've had the patience to listen to me, so perhaps you'll care to hear me grumble, perhaps revealing a couple of juicy tidbits about past events.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueC_02: We really struck it off right off the bat, didn't we? There's this saying that a good story is like fine wine, getting better as it ages, but so many are so obsessed with money that they've forgotten how to taste wine. I'm glad you've decided to stop and listen to an old story over a drink.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueC_03: Aw, I don't believe in coincidences. Everything is ordained by fate. I had such a strong feeling of deja vu when you walked through the door, because I've seen all this in a dream. You were wearing the same clothes, had the same expression on your face, and said the exact same thing as in the dream... Fate must have determined that we are to meet!
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueD_01: This story began with the power outage in the old district eight years ago... no, from a case before that. It was said that some geishas gazed into the mirror late at night, seeing nothing but an empty mask. They were driven mad, and some of them even committed suicide by jumping into a river... Say, how old were you that year?
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueD_02: A story has to be set up by the relevant background info. I'm not just reporting the results, after all. Keep listening, and you'll know whether to believe me when I get to that name.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueD_03: Wait, wait, I haven't gotten to the key point yet—there's no rush, you have to know why he opened the door with his left hand and left before six... It's all foreshadowing, and you'll understand as you keep listening.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueE_01: The shop had been really busy recently. It turned out there were rumors flying around that this was a lucky place for making up a relationship! I mean, all I ever did was help people find out who's been sleeping with whom. There were so many people here to take photos that I put a sign on the door which said, 'Be alone today. Avoid old romances.'
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueE_02: I had a customer who complained he'd been seeing the same psychiatrist for years with no effect. I asked him why he didn't change doctors, and he said he didn't want to hurt his doctor. I asked him how I could help; he said I looked like a scammer and wanted me to scam him. How rude! Then? I told him the tea he ordered was imported and would cost 88,000.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_dialogueE_03: Believe it or not, I've never opened the storage cabinet in the back. Yes, the one behind the TV. It was supposedly left by the previous owner, and you can see your own death when you open it... but this place was new when I rented it. How could there be a previous owner?
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_normalDeal_01: Oh, look at me, I'm babbling again. Please, have a cup of tea, it'll do you good... You haven't finished your tea yet?
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_normalDeal_02: P-Please, don't get angry, I'm almost finished with the story... please, don't go, I mean, have a discount coupon for next time! I'll tell you the ending the next time you're here... hehe...
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_normalDeal_03: Please fill out a satisfaction survey before you leave. On a scale of 1-10, write 10 if you're very satisfied, 9 if you're satisfied, 8 if you're slightly satisfied or not satisfied... Yes, that's right, 8 if you're not satisfied... Hey, please don't go! The survey!
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_highPatience_01: Looks like you still want to hear more, but that's all for today. I have a bunch of reservations afterwards, after all.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_lowPatience_01: Oh, the money's just a small thing. I enjoy chatting with customers who enjoy chatting with me. Let's not talk about money!
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_highAttention_01: The customer laughed before I did... It's like they were even more involved in the story than I was. I better change the next reservation to the morning, because the way those eyes shined was starting to scare me...
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_lowAttention_01: I should try the same story on someone else. The patterns on the table, the wear and tear of the plaque, or the joke of last night's stand-up comedy? Which one should I avoid? ...I guess I should've changed the topic the first time they started looking at their watch.
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_highTrust_01: Why did they believe everything I said? This might be the easiest job ever... Is this even real? Can somebody punch me to check?
keeperDialogMap.shopkeeper_lowTrust_01: It's not the truth we sell—it's trust. Just look at the customer's eyes. Doesn't matter if everything you say is true, if the customer thinks you're lying.

news_01.title: Thousands Gather to Watch Mitsukue Fireworks
news_01.desc1: Customer Interest and Trust <color=#00757c>increase</color> more easily today.
news_01.desc2: Last night's fireworks show was a massive success, with more than a hundred thousand people reported to be in attendance.

news_02.title: Blue Skies Meet Green Scenery in Mitsukue
news_02.desc1: Number of turns until customer becomes irritated is <color=#00757c>increased</color> today.
news_02.desc2: A recent spell of good weather and comfortable temperatures has led to a 40% increase in park visitors across the city.

news_03.title: Mitsukue's Commerce Reaches New Highs
news_03.desc2: A recent uptick in consumption has led to a year-on-year increase of 22% in business district revenue, with multiple brands indicating that they intend to expand their business.

news_04.title: Rumors Fly in Mitsukue
news_04.desc2: Hoshigawa Weekly reports that some yakuza-run stalls are actually selling Originium slug as roasted fins.

news_05.title: Investment Fever Hits Mitsukue
news_05.desc2: The Mitsukue Chamber of Commerce's investment seminar has attracted more than a thousand participants, perhaps helped by the baskets of fowlbeast eggs they gave out.

news_06.title: This Year's Top Shops Revealed
news_06.desc2: The latest 'Top Nita Street Shops' report is out, and Soudanshitsu Mikage leads the pack with a customer satisfaction rate of 99.9%.

news_07.title: Idol Fever Sweeps Mitsukue
news_07.desc1: Chance that Diehard Fan appears <color=#00757c>increased</color> today.
news_07.desc2: Momoka Hanyuu's latest single tops the charts on the day of release, leading to a three-hour traffic jam as fans pack the streets.

news_08.title: Yakuza Troubles Brew in the Shadows
news_08.desc2: Gang-related street violence has been on the rise in recent days, and the police remind citizens to be careful when going out at night.

news_09.title: Locals Complain of Noisy Racers at Night
news_09.desc1: Chance that Street Racer appears <color=#00757c>increased</color> today.
news_09.desc2: Locals are complaining about a gathering of Mitsukue motorbike societies that occurred last night, which attracted hundreds of rumbling modified bikes.

news_10.title: High Society Gathers for Trade Event
news_10.desc2: The Mitsukue Trade Conference drew over ten thousand visitors on its opening day, concluding more than 2 billion mon in expected deals.

PATIENCE.lowerDesc: The customer is out of patience!
PATIENCE.recommendDesc: The customer is beginning to be distracted. Better conclude the deal before they turn around and leave.
PATIENCE.maxDesc: The customer's emotions seem rather stable, showing no resistance to further interaction.

ATTENTION.lowerDesc: Say something that the customer likes to hear and try to do more business.
ATTENTION.recommendDesc: The current transaction amount is fairly good, but there is room for improvement.
ATTENTION.maxDesc: The customer is very interested! I've done good business here.

TRUST.lowerDesc: The customer seems doubtful. Ending the conversation now may lead to failure.
TRUST.recommendDesc: The customer seems to be listening. It may be the time to strike while the iron is hot.
TRUST.maxDesc: Excellent! The customer trusts this information completely. There is no chance of failure!

plot_lhgras.flavorDesc: The ground is overgrown with weeds, which provide soil retention and shelter for small animals. Growing grass and bushes from barren sand is the first step in terraforming in the barrenlands.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: After deployment, immediately grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</>.

plot_lhpark.funcDesc:
Grants more <@trap.number>Training Handbooks</> when deployed. Every <Flower Bush> causes all Operators to recover <@trap.number>1</> HP per second.

Transform: When there are <@trap.number>5</> <Bushes> on the field at the same time, all deployed <Bushes> and future deployed <Bushes> become <Flower Bushes>.
plot_lhpark.flavorDesc: Bushes with flowers growing from them. The stabilized soil and water environment has attracted more creatures, and with them the seeds of flowering plants. The flower bushes are becoming increasingly biodiverse, and plants with medicinal value can be harvested from them.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: After deployment, immediately grants more <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</>.

plot_lhrock.funcDesc: All Operators gain Max HP <@trap.number>+25</>, plus <@trap.number>+5</> Max HP for every <Rock> in the <@trap.number>8</> surrounding tiles.
plot_lhrock.flavorDesc: Rocks formed from complex sediments. They contain various minerals and are important in construction and industry. Mining rocks and extracting metals from them is a necessary step for building an industry in the barrenlands.

plot_lhshan.funcDesc:
All Operators gain Max HP <@trap.number>+500</>.
Transform: <Rocks> deployed in a <@trap.number>3×3</> formation become a <Mountain>.
plot_lhshan.flavorDesc: Rugged mountains that are home to a variety of climates and ecosystems. Home to many plants and animals, as well as rich metal deposits.
plot_lhshan.enemyDesc: A <@trap.monster>Tombkeeper Grotesque</> is spawned when <Mountain> is formed.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Caster Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Tombkeeper Grotesque</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Supporter Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Tombkeeper Grotesque</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Tombkeeper Grotesque</> is defeated.

plot_lhtree.flavorDesc: Many types of trees grow from the soil, providing shade with their sparse canopy. Trees in the barrenlands take root deeply, helping to stabilize the loose, sandy soil. The decay of fallen leaves helps nurture even more life.

plot_lhfrst.funcDesc:
All Operators gain ATK <@trap.number>+20</>.
 
Transform: <Woods> deployed in a <@trap.number>1×3</> formation become a <Forest>.
plot_lhfrst.flavorDesc: A thick, lush forest. As trees compete for sunlight, they create more room for those who live beneath their canopies. Fungi grow on fallen trunks, while those who feed upon the fungi are fed upon by larger creatures, which in turn nourish new saplings with their carcasses.
plot_lhfrst.enemyDesc: A <@trap.monster>Tiacauh Brave</> is spawned when <Forest> is formed.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.monster>Guard Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.drop>Tiacauh Brave</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Vanguard Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Tiacauh Brave</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Tiacauh Brave</> is defeated.

plot_lhhe.funcDesc:
Can only be deployed on map edge or in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles of a <River>. Increases nearby <Terrain> effects. Irrigates any ground tiles in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles, turning them into <Loam>.
<Loam>: Operators on it gain <@trap.number>+50%</> ATK and HP; <Farmland>/<Greenhouse Shed> production is increased.
plot_lhhe.flavorDesc: Man-made river channel, drawing water from nearby. A river quenches the barrenlands, supplies water to agricultural and industrial facilities, and maintains the fragile stability of frontier outposts.
plot_lhhe.enemyDesc: When connected to ground, spawns a <@trap.monster>Dockworker</> or <@trap.monster>Diver</> whenever skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.monster>Guard Advancement Tokens</> and <@trap.drop>Vanguard Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.drop>Dockworker</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Sniper Advancement Tokens</> and <@trap.drop>Specialist Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Diver</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Dockworker</> or <@trap.monster>Diver</> are defeated.

plot_lhphe.funcDesc:
Operators in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles <@trap.debuff>take damage</> each second and have <@trap.number>+50%</> ATK.

Transform: When there are <Originium Formations> around a <River>, any connected <River>/<Loam> become <Polluted River>/<Polluted Loam>.
plot_lhphe.flavorDesc: River polluted by active Originium. Crystal-littered banks are a frequent sight in Catastrophe-heavy areas, turning the river into a different color.

plot_lhport.funcDesc:
When skill is activated, if there are other <Loaders> connected by <Rivers>, creates a transport boat that travels along the <River> to the corresponding <Loader>, providing resources when it arrives. The further the destination, the more resources it grants on arrival.
 
 Transform: <Rivers> become <Loaders> if there is a <Sensor Hub> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles. (Each <Sensor Hub> can only create one <Loader>)
plot_lhport.flavorDesc: Light loader designed for canals. A smart sensor system helps distribute supplies to Rhodes Island cargo boats. The more difficult the environment, the more important teamwork is in order to overcome the challenges.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants all types of <@trap.drop>Elite Advancement Tokens</> when the Transport Boat spawned by skill arrives at destination.

plot_lhmine.funcDesc: Deploy a <Surveyor> to turn it into an <Originium Mine>.

plot_lhmine2.funcDesc:
Grants a small amount of <@trap.drop>Packaged Cores</> when defeated.

Transform: Deploy a <Surveyor> on a <Rich Vein> to turn it into an <Originium Mine>.
plot_lhmine2.flavorDesc: An Originium vein that has been fully surveyed. Rhodes Island is moving forward with the mining operation after a careful review. Originium ore is the foundation of industry, but the extraction and refining process is a major source of pollution.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Packaged Cores</> when <Originium Mine> is destroyed.

plot_lhmine3.funcDesc:
Grants a small amount of <@trap.drop>Packaged Cores</> when defeated.

Transform: <Formation Stabilizer> skill destroys itself and all <Originium Formations> within Attack Range, turning its own tile into an <Originium Mine>.
plot_lhmine3.flavorDesc: An Originium vein that has been fully surveyed. Rhodes Island is moving forward with the mining operation after a careful review. Originium ore is the foundation of industry, but the extraction and refining process is a major source of pollution.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Packaged Cores</> when <Originium Mine> is destroyed.

plot_lhbot.funcDesc: Can attack after deployment while skill is active, dealing Arts damage. If deployed on a <Rich Vein>, turns it into an <Originium Mine> after skill ends.
plot_lhbot.flavorDesc: Portable surveying equipment for field survey missions. The interface is sleek and simple to use, but operators are required to adhere to the manual's instructions to avoid accidentally triggering its fire control system.

plot_lhplt.flavorDesc: Unstable Originium formations that continue to expand. Wind and water can carry active Originium particles a great distance. If left unchecked, they could lead to immeasurable consequences, even Catastrophes.
plot_lhplt.enemyDesc: Spawns <@trap.monster>Radioactive Originium Slugs</> in the 4 adjacent tiles upon spawning.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Radioactive Originium Slug</> is defeated.

plot_lhfac.funcDesc:
Must be deployed on an <Originium Formation>. Gains <@trap.number>1</> SP per second for each <Originium Formation> within Attack Range;
when skill is activated, destroys self and any <Originium Formations> within Attack Range, turning its own tile into an <Originium Mine>.
plot_lhfac.flavorDesc: Emergency pollution cleanup equipment powered directly by airborne active Originium particles. Effective at reducing the risk of Originium explosions in an area, but ultimately the pollution problem must be tackled at the source.
plot_lhfac.enemyDesc: Spawns several sleeping <@trap.monster>Vein Guardians</> in the 4 adjacent tiles when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.monster>Guard Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.drop>Vein Guardian</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.monster>Vanguard Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.drop>Vein Guardian</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.monster>Skill Handbooks</> when <@trap.drop>Vein Guardian</> is defeated.

plot_lhfarm.funcDesc: Gains SP when Infected Creatures are defeated; if said Creatures are defeated within its Attack Range, gains doubled SP.
plot_lhfarm.flavorDesc: A catalytic reactor that effectively collects active Originium particles, generating clean energy for the frontier outpost.
plot_lhfarm.enemyDesc: Spawns several <@trap.monster>Originium Slugs β</> in the 4 adjacent tiles when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Originium Slug β</> is defeated or when skill is activated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Strategic Beacons</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhfacp.funcDesc:
Gains SP when Infected Creatures are defeated; if said Creatures are defeated within its Attack Range, gains doubled SP.

Transform: <Originium Recycler> becomes <Polluted Recycler> when there is an <Originium Formation> around it.
plot_lhfacp.flavorDesc: When captured active Originium particles exceed a certain threshold, the Originium Recycler begins to operate differently, concentrating active Originium particles to generate Originium fuel that is used in the outpost's factories.
plot_lhfacp.enemyDesc: Spawns sleeping <@trap.monster>Infused Originium Slugs</> in the 4 adjacent tiles when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants more <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Infused Originium Slug</> is defeated or when skill is activated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Packaged Cores</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhshop.funcDesc:
Gains SP whenever a new Armory Plug-in is obtained; when skill is activated, grants <@trap.number>1</> <@trap.drop>Improved Armory Plug-in</> or <@trap.drop>Advanced Armory Plug-in</>; for every <@trap.number>2</> skill activations, grant <@trap.number>1</> more <Plug-in Upgrade Depot>.
<Plug-in Upgrade Depot> spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Teary Detective</> or <@trap.monster>Defense Crusher</> when skill is activated. Defeat them to upgrade 1 random equipped Armory Plug-in.
plot_lhshop.flavorDesc: Mobile industrial platform equipped with a foundry module, traveling across rough terrain to where the raw materials are produced, processing them directly at the source and reducing time overhead.
plot_lhshop.enemyDesc: Spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Teary Detective</> or <@trap.monster>Defense Crusher</> when <Plug-in Upgrade Depot> skill is activated.

plot_lhpad.funcDesc: Recovers SP over time. <@trap.debuff>Loses SP</> when an enemy passes through.
plot_lhpad.flavorDesc: Fenced-off land that can be used to grow crops. The soil nutrient mix can be adjusted based on the crop, and small cultivators are available to prevent soil crusting.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhpad2.funcDesc:
Recovers SP over time. <@trap.debuff>Loses SP</> when an enemy passes through.

 Transform: <Farmland> deployed in a <@trap.number>1×3</> formation becomes a <Greenhouse Shed>.
plot_lhpad2.flavorDesc: Greenhouse shed for scaled agricultural production, increasing efficiency while reducing the impact that natural conditions have on agriculture. The lighting, temperature, and humidity can be adjusted in zones based on plant needs.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants more <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhnat.funcDesc: Every 5s, restores the SP of Production Modules within Attack Range, and causes all Operator skills to activate automatically (effect does not stack).
plot_lhnat.flavorDesc: Energy transmission is always a major challenge when building in the barrenlands. A comprehensive and efficient power grid relies on power supply stations like these to act as both hub and node. Rhodes Island's remote computing and deployment strategy has significantly reduced energy loss.

plot_lhcol.funcDesc: Recovers SP when Production Modules are obtained.
plot_lhcol.flavorDesc: Libraries continue to play an irreplaceable role in the retention and transmission of knowledge. Although Rhodes Island is equipped with a highly digitized information storage system, tried-and-true pen and paper remain an important medium for passing down skills and experiences.
plot_lhcol.enemyDesc: Spawns sleeping <@trap.monster>Senior Casters</> in the 4 adjacent tiles when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Caster Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Senior Caster</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Supporter Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Senior Caster</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhdoor.funcDesc: Recovers SP over time; when skill is activated, teleports <@trap.number>1</> enemy from this tile to the nearest reachable Operator.
plot_lhdoor.flavorDesc: Sarkaz witchcraft being used to transfer personnel and supplies over vast distances on the battlefield has left a deep impression on observers from many factions. Rhodes Island engineers have made improvements on the ancient witchcraft altar with modern Originium technology.

plot_lhcolb.funcDesc:
Recovers SP when Production Modules are obtained; when skill is activated, chance to drop a <@trap.drop>Production Module</>.

Transform: <Archives> become <Great Libraries> when there is an <Improved Witchcraft Altar> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles.
plot_lhcolb.flavorDesc: Libraries continue to play an irreplaceable role in the retention and transmission of knowledge. The walls of the library do not represent the boundaries of knowledge, though the size of the shelves have a certain correlation with the depth of acquisition.
plot_lhcolb.enemyDesc: Spawns sleeping <@trap.monster>Shielded Senior Casters</> in the 4 adjacent tiles when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants more <@trap.drop>Caster Advancement Token</> when <@trap.monster>Shielded Senior Caster</> is defeated.
Grants more <@trap.drop>Supporter Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Shielded Senior Caster</> is defeated.
Grants more <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhvlg.funcDesc: When skill is activated, spawns an <Advance Detector> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles. One random enemy within skill range gains <@trap.debuff>+50%</> ATK and Max HP; defeat it to gain <@trap.number>1</> <@trap.drop>Basic Armory Plug-in</>. The 4th <Advance Detector> spawned this way will not spawn any additional <Advance Detectors> when its skill is activated.
plot_lhvlg.flavorDesc: Detector that Closure designed for the barrenlands. An encrypted ZOOT channel enables remote proxy operation, while environmental data collected by the detectors is analyzed by ZOOT to compute the optimal strategy.

plot_lhtown.funcDesc:
Gains SP every <@trap.number>5</>s for each <Advance Detector> and other <Sensor Hub> on the field. Grants <@trap.number>1</> <@trap.drop>Plug-in Supply Depot</> whenever a <@trap.monster>Sponsor Drone</> spawned by the skill is defeated.
<Plug-in Supply Depot> Grants 1<@trap.drop>Advanced Armory Plug-in</> when an enemy spawned by the skill is defeated.

Transform: <Advance Sensors> deployed in a <@trap.number>3×3</> formation become a <Sensor Hub>.
plot_lhtown.flavorDesc: Sensor hub that Closure designed for the barrenlands, comprising multiple Advance Detectors. The computing cluster allows ZOOT to establish more automated patrol and detection programs to ensure the safety of the outpost.
plot_lhtown.enemyDesc: Spawns <@trap.monster>Sponsor Drone</> or <@trap.monster>Blocker</> when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Sniper Advancement Token</> when <@trap.monster>Blocker</> and <@trap.monster>Sponsor Drone</> are defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Specialist Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Blocker</> and <@trap.monster>Sponsor Drone</> are defeated.

plot_lhbat.funcDesc: Recovers SP when an enemy is defeated in the 8 surrounding tiles; chance to grant <@trap.number>1</> <@trap.drop>Basic Armory Plug-in</> when skill is activated.
plot_lhbat.flavorDesc: The scars of the Battle of Londinium continue to haunt Victoria. Those who clean up the battlefield have no way of knowing whether they are digging up something useful, or waking a blood artifact from its slumber.
plot_lhbat.enemyDesc: Chance to spawn <@trap.monster>Touch of the Sanguinarch</> when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Touch of the Sanguinarch</> is defeated.

plot_lharen.funcDesc:
Recovers SP over time; Operators on it recover <@trap.number>3%</> of their Max HP per second.
 
 Transform: <Cursed Bloodgrounds> become <Impact Fences> when there is a <Sensor Hub> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles.
plot_lharen.flavorDesc: A place for settlers to settle a score. The history of humanity is the history of conflict, and some are willing to put their lives on the line to decide a winner. With the advent of commercialization and the popularity of competitive sports, however, duels have become more symbolic and less deadly.
plot_lharen.enemyDesc: Randomly spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Kazimierz enemy</> when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Depending on the type of Kazimierz Knight defeated, grants one of the following combinations: <@trap.drop>Vanguard Advancement Token</> and <@trap.drop>Guard Advancement Token</>, <@trap.drop>Defender Advancement Token</> and <@trap.drop>Medic Advancement Token</>, or <@trap.drop>Sniper Advancement Token</> and <@trap.drop>Specialist Advancement Token</>.
Chance to grant <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> based on type of Kazimierz Knight defeated.
Defeat Kazimierz Knight to gain <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</>.

plot_lhruin.funcDesc: Chance to drop 1 <@trap.drop>Basic Armory Plug-in</> when destroyed.
plot_lhruin.flavorDesc: Ruined buildings that one often sees in the barrenlands. Time always takes its toll, be it on stone columns belonging to the palaces of ambitious conquerors, or tiny shacks belonging to those barely surviving. But those who come after will pick up the stone and wood, and build new houses of their own.

plot_lhsht.funcDesc: High ground units can be deployed on its tile.
plot_lhsht.flavorDesc: Outpost built from ruined buildings, allowing operators to monitor enemy movement and attack from a distance. There are no walls to block the wind, nor a roof to block the sun, but at least it offers solid footing.

plot_lhsht2.funcDesc:
High ground units can be deployed on its tile.

Transform: <Ruins> become <Outposts> when destroyed.
plot_lhsht2.flavorDesc: Outpost built from ruined buildings, allowing operators to monitor enemy movement and attack from a distance. There are no walls to block the wind, nor a roof to block the sun, but at least it offers solid footing.

plot_lhmagd.funcDesc:
High ground units can be deployed on its tile. Operators on it gain <@trap.number>+100%</> ATK when skill is active. Buff is reduced by 50% for each subsequent activation (no effect after 2 activations).

Transform: <Outposts> becomes <Arts Outposts> when there is a <Archive>/<Great Library> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles.
plot_lhmagd.flavorDesc: Outpost modified with Arts from the library's collection.

plot_lhmagd2.funcDesc:
High ground units can be deployed on its tile. Operators on it gain <@trap.number>+100%</> ATK when skill is active. Buff is reduced by 50% for each subsequent activation (no effect after 2 activations).

Transform: <Outposts> becomes <Arts Outposts> when there is a <Archive>/<Great Library> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles.
plot_lhmagd2.flavorDesc: Outpost modified with Arts from the library's collection.

plot_lhtwer.funcDesc:
High ground units can be deployed on its tile. Operators on it <@trap.debuff>no longer recover SP over time</>, but gain <@trap.number>+5</> ASPD (max 300) whenever they attack.

Transform: <Outposts> becomes <Warning Outposts> when there is an <Advance Detector>/<Sensor Hub> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles.
plot_lhtwer.flavorDesc: Outpost linked to ZOOT's sensor system. The fire control system has been optimized based on the strategy that ZOOT computed.

plot_lhtwer2.funcDesc:
High ground units can be deployed on its tile. Operators on it <@trap.debuff>no longer recover SP over time</>, but gain <@trap.number>+5</> ASPD (max 300) whenever they attack.

Transform: <Outposts> becomes <Warning Outposts> when there is an <Advance Detector>/<Sensor Hub> in the <@trap.number>4</> adjacent tiles.
plot_lhtwer2.flavorDesc: Outpost linked to ZOOT's sensor system. The fire control system has been optimized based on the strategy that ZOOT computed.

plot_lhcamp.funcDesc: Recovers SP when enemies pass through. Becomes a new Production Module if there are certain Production Modules within Attack Range.
plot_lhcamp.flavorDesc: Simple village built by people who once lost their homes. Supplies are scarce and access is poor, but it is a home they cherish. They are cautious but curious about the changes around them.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Junkman</> is defeated.

plot_lhswer.funcDesc:
Recovers SP when enemies pass through.

Transform: <Wilderness Villages> becomes <Waterside Villages> when there is an <Advance Detector>/<Sensor Hub> within Attack Range.
plot_lhswer.flavorDesc: Simple village built by people who once lost their homes. The inhabitants found Rhodes Island's sensors and wanted to sell their catch to the outsiders who built the devices, but all they saw were a few drones, so they decided to go out with their metal crabs to peddle them.
plot_lhswer.enemyDesc: Spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Metal Crab</> when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Defender Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Metal Crab</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Specialist Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Metal Crab</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Metal Crab</> is defeated.

plot_lhcampa.funcDesc:
Recovers SP when enemies pass through.

Transform: <Wilderness Villages> becomes <Hunting Villages> when there is a <Woods>/<Forest> within Attack Range.
plot_lhcampa.flavorDesc: Simple village built by people who once lost their homes. The inhabitants found the forests that appeared nearby, so they bought bows and arrows to hunt, but became lost in the misty woods. They see everything as their quarry in their hungered hallucinations.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Sniper Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Sniper</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.monster>Specialist Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.drop>Sniper</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Sniper</> is defeated.

plot_lhcampb.funcDesc:
Recovers SP when enemies pass through.

Transform: <Wilderness Villages> becomes <Hill Villages> when there is a <Rock>/<Mountain> within Attack Range.
plot_lhcampb.flavorDesc: Simple village built by people who once lost their homes. The inhabitants found the mountains that appeared nearby, so they splurged on armor only to forget to save money for explosives. They must find a way to sell their almost-new shields, by force if necessary.
plot_lhcampb.enemyDesc: Spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Heavy Defender</> when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Defender Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Heavy Defender</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Medic Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Heavy Defender</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Heavy Defender</> is defeated.

plot_lhcampc.funcDesc:
Recovers SP when enemies pass through.

Transform: <Wilderness Villages> becomes <Pasture Villages> when there is a <Bush>/<Flower Bush> within Attack Range.
plot_lhcampc.flavorDesc: Simple village built by people who once lost their homes. The inhabitants found the grass that appeared nearby, so they wanted to start a cystymilk ranch, but the beasts they bought would not give milk. Angry at their treatment, the mossback beasts the villagers thought were cystybeasts destroyed their pens and escaped.
plot_lhcampc.enemyDesc: Spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Mossback Beast</> when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Guard Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Mossback Beast</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Vanguard Advancement Tokens</> when <@trap.monster>Mossback Beast</> is defeated.
Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Mossback Beast</> is defeated.

plot_lhrift.funcDesc:
Recovers SP when enemies pass through.

Transform: <Wilderness Villages> becomes <Witchcraft Villages> when there is a <Improved Witchcraft Altar> within Attack Range. If there is already a <Witchcraft Village> on the field, newly deployed <Wilderness Villages> also become <Witchcraft Villages> if there are no other available transformations.
plot_lhrift.flavorDesc: Simple village built by people who once lost their homes. The inhabitants found an improved witchcraft altar and tried to teach themselves witchcraft in order to create Pure Gold at the altar, but their haphazard incantations ended up summoning a man-eating machine.
plot_lhrift.enemyDesc: Spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Rampaging Vacuum</> when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants one of the following combinations when <@trap.monster>Rampaging Vacuum</> is defeated: <@trap.drop>Vanguard Advancement Token</> and <@trap.drop>Guard Advancement Token</>, <@trap.drop>Defender Advancement Token</> and <@trap.drop>Medic Advancement Token</>, <@trap.drop>Sniper Advancement Token</> and <@trap.drop>Specialist Advancement Token</>, or <@trap.drop>Supporter Advancement Token</> and <@trap.drop>Caster Advancement Token</>.
Grants <@trap.drop>Training Handbooks</> when <@trap.monster>Rampaging Vacuum</> is defeated.

plot_lheqp.funcDesc:
Grants 1 <@trap.drop>Advanced Armory Plug-in</> when enemy spawned by skill is defeated.

Transform: <@trap.number>1</> <@trap.drop>Plug-in Supply Depot</> is granted when <@trap.monster>Sponsor Drone</> spawned by <Sensor Hub> skill is defeated.
plot_lheqp.flavorDesc: A depot for receiving supplies. Equipment from Rhodes Island HQ is sent to this location.
plot_lheqp.enemyDesc: Spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Wilderness Rogue</> or <@trap.monster>None of My Business</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhupgd.funcDesc:
Spawns <@trap.monster>Teary Detective</> or <@trap.monster>Defense Crusher</> when skill is activated. Defeat to upgrade a random equipped Armory Plug-in.

Transform: <@trap.number>1</> <Plug-in Upgrade Depot> is granted when <Foundry Car> activates skill twice.
plot_lhupgd.flavorDesc: A depot for receiving supplies. Upgrades from Rhodes Island HQ are sent to this location.
plot_lhupgd.enemyDesc: Spawns 1 <@trap.monster>Teary Detective</> or <@trap.monster>Defense Crusher</> when skill is activated.

plot_lhside.funcDesc: When skill is activated, Operators within range gain <@trap.number>+2%</> ATK and <@trap.number>+2%</> HP for 30s for each Production Module within range other than itself (does not stack).
plot_lhside.flavorDesc: Real-time communication is always a major challenge when building in the barrenlands. A comprehensive and efficient communications network relies on base stations like these to act as both hub and node. Effective communications amongst operators has significantly improved their work efficiency.

plot_lhblod.funcDesc: <@trap.debuff>Continuously deals damage</> to allied units within Attack Range and recovers SP. Destroyed when skill is activated.
plot_lhblod.flavorDesc: An altar that nurtures the Bloodborn, reeking of blood and witchcraft. Ominous altars were spotted in the wilderness after the Battle of Londinium, hungrily harvesting blood from those who pass by. When sufficiently nourished, the Bloodborn within will break out of their altar.
plot_lhblod.enemyDesc: Spawns <@trap.monster>Blood Amber</> in the 8 adjacent tiles when skill is activated.

itemDropData.itemDropDesc: Grants <@trap.drop>Skill Handbooks</> when skill is activated.

poolTypeData.desc:
Spend a certain number of Packaged Cores to perform a Random Appointment.
*If no 6-star Operators appear in the first 50 attempts, the chance to gain a 6-star Operator will increase by 2% each subsequent attempt. Chance is reset once you obtain a 6-star Operator.
*Pool description: <@gacha.text>1-star</> and <@gacha.text>2-star Operators</>, Operators included in <@gacha.text>Specialized Appointment and Mobilization Order</>, and <@gacha.text>unowned collab Operators</> are excluded from the pool of appointable Operators.

Spend 1 Refined Core to perform a Specialized Appointment from a specific pool.
**Operators appointed from Specialized Appointment are directly available in Rebuilding Mandate, whether you own them or not, and training costs are reduced.
*Pool description: Appointable Operators include <@gacha.text>SilverAsh</>, <@gacha.text>Exusiai</>, <@gacha.text>Angelina</>, <@gacha.text>Passenger</>, <@gacha.text>Thorns</>, <@gacha.text>Mountain</>, <@gacha.text>Blaze</>, <@gacha.text>Saria</>, <@gacha.text>Fiammetta</>, <@gacha.text>Eyjafjalla</>, <@gacha.text>Ifrit</>, and <@gacha.text>Phantom</>.

Spend Mobilization Orders to obtain Operators of your choice from a specific pool
*Operators appointed from Mobilization Orders are directly available in Rebuilding Mandate, whether you own them or not, and training costs are reduced.

Spend a certain number of Exceptional Invitations to appoint a 6-star Operator of your choice.
*Special rule: number of Exceptional Invitations required increases with each use.
*Pool description: <@gacha.text>Default squads</>, Operators included in <@gacha.text>Specialized Appointment and Mobilization Order</>, and <@gacha.text>unowned collab Operators</> are excluded from the pool of appointable Operators.

letter_1.mailContent: I heard the stage setup for the masquerade has begun? I, as a fan, definitely have to help out! Don't be shy, these are old tables from Rhodes Island that were just sitting around, and I've refurbished them to suit the band's style. They'll definitely come in handy! So, please make sure to invite me to the masquerade!

letter_2.mailContent: These are stage decorations my bandmates and I prepared. Hope they can be of some use. As a fellow band member from Rhodes Island, if there's anything else you need help with, just ask. Even when things get tough, we play without holding back—isn't that what rock and roll is about? Let's jam sometime!

letter_3.mailContent: Hello, these are the lighting fixtures from your order. We've adjusted their appearance to match the requested style. After confirmation, we'll help install them on the stage. Well, I don't quite understand it, but this stage really looks so amazing and cool. If it's possible, could I bring my friends to attend too? It's sure to be a truly magnificent and unforgettable masquerade!

letter_4.mailTitle: A Message from the Castle of Dreams
letter_4.mailContent:
How are the members of Ave Mujica doing? I heard that your masquerade on Rhodes Island is being diligently prepared, so please allow me to contribute as well.
These were originally furniture pieces from the Castle of Dreams, and I've sent them over to add some vibe to the masquerade. We are very much looking forward to the official start of the masquerade, and the children are also impatient. I wish you all the best.

letter_5.mailTitle: Recording from the Castle of Dreams
letter_5.mailContent: Ugh... Iris asked me to apologize to you, so I just... I went too far before, and caused you unnecessary trouble. I'm truly sorry. Please take these stage backdrops Corettons and I made together... Is that enough now, Iris! Ahh, I don't care anymore, just let it be!! I really hope your masquerade is a success, otherwise Iris will surely nag me again!

station_rebuild_01.stageDesc:
Only ruins are left here, but all is not lost.
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> Random several nodes grant 2x base resource production every 2 rounds
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_02.stageDesc:
Food, firewood, and medicine. Help from good neighbors and 'good neighbors' have arrived together.
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> Random several nodes grant 2x base resource production every 2 rounds
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_03.stageDesc:
Hey, look what we found!
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> All nodes' resource types are reset at random every 2 rounds
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_04.stageDesc:
Some things matter more. You win some, you lose some.
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> Every 2 rounds, 4 random nodes lock and yield no resources; others grant more resources
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_05.stageDesc:
She said, 'Remember the path you walked, and let not yourself forget.'
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> All nodes start with reduced base production; each time you complete a full lap, all nodes' base resource production +1
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-3 (random)

station_rebuild_06.stageDesc:
Look down and harvest the fruits of the earth; look up and catch the stars.
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> Chests appear in random nodes every 2 rounds and last for 2 rounds; passing them grants random resources
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_07.stageDesc:
Creating a list of unfinished work does wonders for efficiency.
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> Start with fewer Repair Plans; +1 Repair Plan for every 2 Reconstruction Points earned (max +4)
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_08.stageDesc:
Almost there!
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> Start with fewer Repair Plans; +1 Repair Plan for every 2 Reconstruction Points earned (max +4)
All nodes' resource types are reset at random every 2 rounds
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_09.stageDesc:
Last check—nothing loose or left behind.
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> Start with fewer Repair Plans; +1 Plan for every 2 Points earned (max +4)
Every 2 rounds, 4 random nodes lock and yield no resources; others grant more resources
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-5 (random)

station_rebuild_10.stageDesc:
Spring's come to Kjerag as promised.
<color=#df5244><Set Effect></color> All nodes' base production reduced; +2 after every full lap
Chests appear in random nodes every 2 rounds and last for 2 rounds; passing them grants random resources
<color=#df5244><Repair Plan Range></color> 1-3 (random)
