FAIL.dialogText: The numbers don't line up? Let me see the repair plan.
Oh... Well, don't get discouraged. Let's do it again, together.
Kjeragandr guides our path...
You must advance once before collecting resources. In addition, using Repair Plans with ascending consecutive numbers during resource collection can improve collection efficiency.

Repair Plans with ascending consecutive numbers can be used consecutively while collecting resources, and each consecutive use grants an additional amount of all resource types. Make good use of this.

GOOD.dialogText: Completion, information, and personnel... you handle everything very well, Doctor.
Ah, you're that dok... dok... dok-something that the Saintess was talking about? My neighbors asked me to bring you some toffee. Enjoy, and thanks for everything you've done!
Welcome, ally. Repair progress? Oh, we know you'll do a good job of it. Our time can be used on more productive things.
It's been a while, Doctor. Thank you for your help. Come to the Vine-Bead Court for dinner when you have the time. The clerics are looking forward to talking to someone as learned as you.
A reasonable result. Lacking in surprises, pleasant or otherwise, but sometimes compromise is the best option.

Welcome, ally. Repair progress? Oh, we know you'll do a good job of it. Our time can be used on more productive things.
It's been a while, Doctor. Thank you for your help. Come to the Vine-Bead Court for dinner when you have the time. The clerics are looking forward to talking to someone as learned as you.
A reasonable result. Lacking in surprises, pleasant or otherwise, but sometimes compromise is the best option.
You must advance once before collecting resources. In addition, using Repair Plans with ascending consecutive numbers during resource collection can improve collection efficiency.

Repair Plans with ascending consecutive numbers can be used consecutively while collecting resources, and each consecutive use grants an additional amount of all resource types. Make good use of this.

EXCELLENT.dialogText: An outstanding outcome. You never disappoint. Suffice to say that I'm glad you're a friend of Kjerag, not her enemy.

Come, Doctor. I can already hear the workers and villagers calling to you. Countless people want to thank you—maybe you could set aside some time before the ribbon-cutting to let them shake your hand.
Mind if I make a copy of this schedule? I want to refer to it when tweaking my experiment schedule. No problem? Great!

FAIL.dialogText: The numbers don't line up? Let me see the repair plan.
Oh... Well, don't get discouraged. Let's do it again, together.
Kjeragandr guides our path...

mode_single_hard.name: Dire Simulation
mode_single_hard.desc: A simulation with very dangerous enemies

mode_single_abyss.name: Ultimate Simulation
mode_single_abyss.desc: A simulation with extremely strong enemies
mode_single_abyss.unlockText: Complete Dire Simulation 2 times to unlock

mode_multi_hard.name: Dire Simulation
mode_multi_hard.desc: A simulation with very dangerous enemies

mode_multi_abyss.name: Ultimate Simulation
mode_multi_abyss.desc: A simulation with extremely strong enemies
mode_multi_abyss.unlockText: Complete Dire Simulation 2 times to unlock

band_bldsk.bandDesc: [Intensive Monitoring] When the battle starts, +2 Alliance Stacks to 1 random Operator of each different Tier on the field

band_amiya.bandDesc: [Wills As One] When there are 3/4/5 different active Alliances, all Operators +20/30/40% ATK and HP respectively

band_duyaoy.bandDesc:
[Heroes All Around] The first two manual refreshes in every round become a special refresh: This refresh will prioritize offering 1 Yan Operator
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some Yan Operators are missing</>

band_orchid.bandDesc:
[HR Consultant] Every manual refresh becomes a special refresh: 2 copies of the same Operator will appear with one Frozen; obtain 1 Dispatch Module on Round 10
<@ba.acrem><Dispatch Module> Destroyed when equipped and immediately refreshes Dispatch Center once, offering three Operators from the same Alliance as the equipping Operator. Pick one for free! (Operator Tier cannot exceed the current Dispatch Center Level)</>

band_justin.bandDesc:
[Private Equity Fund] Upon entering Rest Phase on Rounds 1, 4, 7, 10, obtain 1 Knightly Savings
<@ba.acrem><Knightly Savings> Destroyed when equipped and grants 1-6 Funds</>

band_ermengard.bandDesc: [Phylactery Secret] First 3 Operators defeated in battle will be revived immediately!

band_lmlee.bandDesc: [Idle Teatime] Funds from Rounds 1 and 2 are temporarily held and released on Round 3; randomly obtain 1 Tier 2 Operator and 1 Tier 4 Operator during Round 3's Rest Phase

band_kirara.bandDesc: [Completion Reward] For every 20 Funds spent, gain a random Operator from a Tier not exceeding the current Dispatch Center Level

band_pepe.bandDesc:
[Erudite and Versatile] When Dispatch Center reaches Lv. 2, 4, and 6, obtain 1 special refresh: This refresh will prioritize offering <Sargon> Operators
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Sargon> Operators are missing</>

band_harold.bandDesc:
[Talent Blind Box] Starting from Round 4, obtain 1 <Victoria> Operator every 2 rounds
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Victoria> Operators are missing</>

band_sciurus.bandDesc:
[Snowfield's Gift] The first <Kjerag> Operator purchased every round costs 1 Funds
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Kjerag> Operators are missing</>

band_paganini.bandDesc:
[Customized Firearm] After spending a total of 55 Funds, obtain 1 Tier 4 or above Elite Laterano Operator
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Lateran> Operators are missing</>

band_clementia.bandDesc:
[Noble Sacrifice] When an <Ægir> Operator is defeated, grants Ægir Alliance stacks equivalent to that Operator's Tier
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Ægir> Operators are missing</>

band_emperor.bandDesc: [Express Dispatch] All allied Operators -50% Redeployment Time after each deployment

band_mberry.bandDesc: [Experimental Med. Sticks] When the battle begins, all allied Operators in the rightmost column of the field gain the following effect: Every attack has a 25% chance to grant 1 Shield (max 1 stack)

band_humus.bandDesc: [Recycling] When a Ground Operator's skill ends, they grant 3 SP to 1 random Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles

band_quintus.bandDesc:
[Unstable Element] In Round 3, obtain special equipment Mutated Cells
<@ba.acrem><Mutated Cells> After the battle ends, equipped Operator changes to a random Operator 1 Tier higher (up to Tier 6)</>

band_yu.bandDesc: [Slow Simmer] When Round 8 begins, if there is only 1 active Alliance, +36 stacks to it; otherwise +12 stacks to all active Alliances

band_doberm.bandDesc:
[Extra Training!] Obtain 1 'Pointing Stick' special Arts every 2 rounds
<@ba.acrem>When used, adds extra enemies to the field and grants extra funds if the battle is perfectly cleared on your own</>

band_cathy.bandDesc: [Targeted Drop] Whenever the Dispatch Center is upgraded, the shop offers 1 free Equipment with 3 random options to choose from

band_malkie.bandDesc:
[Commercial Packaging] Start with 1 Commercial Packaging Plan
<@ba.acrem><Commercial Packaging Plan> For every 8 Operators sold, obtain 1 non-Elite Operator from the same Alliance as the equipped Operator</>

band_qalaisa.bandDesc: [Scavenger Butterfly] When an allied Operator is defeated, other allied units on the field gain +20% ATK (Max 200%, and lasts until Operators are defeated or the battle ends)

band_chen.bandDesc: [Personal Power] All Operators deal Weakness damage (When dealing Physical or Arts damage, change damage type depending on the target's DEF and RES)

band_damaztic.bandDesc:
[Damazti Isomorphism] Obtain 1 special equipment Damazti Isomorph every 5 rounds
<@ba.acrem><Damazti Isomorph> When equipped together with certain other equipment, the equipped Operator is treated as a member of a specific Alliance</>

band_pith.bandDesc: [Top Student] In Round 1, gain 1 special Operator that can deal Nervous Impairment, Burn, or Necrosis. This Operator also belongs to the Harmony Alliance: +1 Operator count to some Alliances

band_dusk.bandDesc:
[Inky Visage] Duplicate Operators on the field have +30% ATK
[Painted into Reality] In Round 1, obtain Special Arts Dusk's Scroll
<@ba.acrem><Dusk's Scroll> On use, can copy 1 Operator within use range (Includes that Operator's Elite status and carried Equipment)</>

band_cannot.bandDesc: [Compound Interest] Leftover Funds can be saved for the next round. When there are at least 5 Funds left, gain 1 extra Funds per round

band_ducklord.bandDesc: ['Mystery Customer'] From Round 5 onwards, some enemies you and your teammates encounter may be replaced with <Duck Lord>, <Gopnik>, <Crying Thief>, or <Fatty>. Defeating them (even during Unite Phases) will grant 1 Funds

band_lisa.bandDesc: [Omamori's Blessing] When a round begins, trigger an Operator's 'When obtained' Attribute once (prioritizes the bottom-right-most Operator on map)

band_vodfox.bandDesc: [Substitute Doll] The first non-Elite Operator sold every round will instead switch into a random Operator from the Dispatch Center

band_ioleta.bandDesc: [Governing Order] When the battle begins, for every Elite Operator on the field, Elite Operators gain +10% ATK and HP

band_jesica.bandDesc:
[Rally Directive] Upon entering Rest Phase on Round 4, 7, 10, and 13, obtain 1 Dispatch Module
<@ba.acrem><Dispatch Module> Destroyed when equipped and immediately refreshes Dispatch Center once, offering three Operators from the same Alliance as the equipping Operator. Pick one for free! (Operator Tier cannot exceed the current Dispatch Center Level)</>

band_mlyss.bandDesc:
[Purified Condensation] Obtain 1 upgraded Doctor Hologram on Round 1
<@ba.acrem>Upgraded <Doctor Hologram> Equippable by any Operator; immediately promotes Operator to an Elite Operator</>

band_makiri.bandDesc: [Streetwise Ties] Obtain a random Operator from the Dispatch Center on even-numbered rounds

band_fang.bandDesc:
[Joint Advance] Obtain 1 Transmitter on rounds 8, 10, 12, and 14
<@ba.acrem><Transmitter> Destroys equipped Operator when equipped and refreshes two slots in Dispatch Center, offering 2 Operators of the same Tier and pick one for free; the original Operator will be sent to your friend with the highest corresponding Alliance stack in the next round</>

band_mlynar.bandDesc:
[Work Quota] Every <Kazimierz> Operator purchased grants 1 extra Funds next round (Max 3 Funds per round)
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Kazimierz> Operators are missing</>

band_chiave.bandDesc:
[Gang Activity] Every 6 active refreshes will grant you 1 <Siracusa> Operator from a Tier not exceeding the Dispatch Center Level (Max 2 Operators per round)
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Siracusa> Operators are missing</>

band_narant.bandDesc:
[Passing Down the Profit] Dispatch Center will offer two equipment during even-numbered rounds, and you can pick one for free; Sargon Alliance's <With 6 different Sargon Operators> effect changes to: After Sargon Operators use a skill, Operators in the surrounding 8 tiles will share the Operator's equipment effects (limited to Tier V and below) for 60 seconds
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Sargon> Operators are missing</>

band_amedic.bandDesc: [Field Medic] 1 Reserve Operator - Medic appears on each player's battlefield; if there are at least 2 Elite Operators when the battle begins, Reserve Operator turns into <Touch>

yanShip.name: Yan
yanShip.desc:
[Yan] Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Yan] Operators on field> At the start of battle, <@ba.vup>'Yan's Protection'</> is summoned with ATK and HP equal to 30% of the total ATK and HP of all [Yan] Operators on the field; can attack 3 targets simultaneously; can use <@ba.vup>'Cleansing Flame'</>; attacks inflict a percentage of ATK as Burn and inflicts Elemental Fragility on surrounding enemies
<With <@autochess.dgreen>9</> different [Yan] Operators on field> summons 2 <@ba.vup>'Yan's Protection'</> instead, with <@ba.vup>1.5x</> ATK and <@ba.vup>90%</> damage reduction

sargonShip.name: Sargon
sargonShip.desc:
When any [Sargon] Operator activates a skill, all [Sargon] Operators temporarily gain increased <@ba.vup>ASPD</> (up to a limit) for a duration <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Sargon] Operators on field> Skill activations will also cause all [Sargon] Operators to temporarily gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> (up to a limit) for the same duration
<@ba.acrem> When using Narantuya's Strategy, <With 6 different [Sargon] Operators on field> effect changes</>

victoriaShip.name: Victoria
victoriaShip.desc:
[Victoria] Operators carrying equipment deal <@ba.vup>more damage</><@autochess.gray> (affected by no. of stacks)</>
<For every <@autochess.dgreen>25</> stacks> Obtain 1 random <@ba.vup>Victorian Hammer</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Victoria] Operators on field> All [Victoria] Operators carrying equipment gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</>, with an extra increase if equipment is upgraded

kjeragShip.name: Kjerag
kjeragShip.desc:
[Kjerag] Operators deal <@ba.vup>increased damage</>, and even more to <@ba.vup>Cold and Frozen</> enemies <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Kjerag] Operators on field> A chill gust blows on the battlefield every 25 seconds, inflicting Cold on enemies for a period of time <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>

lateranoShip.name: Laterano
lateranoShip.desc:
[Laterano] Operators gain <@ba.vup>ammo</> on skill activation <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Laterano] Operators on field> All [Laterano] Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> (up to a limit) when any [Laterano] Operator spends 1 bullet

egirShip.name: Ægir
egirShip.desc:
[Ægir] Operators' <@ba.vup>HP</> increases <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
When the battle begins, [Ægir] Operators will <@ba.vup>devour</> the Operator on the tile in front of them, dealing <@ba.vdown>5000</> Physical damage to the Operator and gaining their <@ba.vup>base ATK</> and <@ba.vup>Block</>, while adding [Ægir] <@ba.vup>stacks</><@autochess.gray> equal to the devoured Operator's Tier (among [Ægir] Operators, those positioned further up or to the left are prioritized to start a devour)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>5</> different [Ægir] Operators on field> The first 3 defeated will <@ba.vup>immediately revive</>

siracusaShip.name: Siracusa
siracusaShip.desc:
[Siracusa] Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>ASPD</> on deployment for a period of time <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Siracusa] Operators on field> [Siracusa] Operators also gain Invisibility for the same amount of time; and have <@ba.vup>3%</> chance to deal a set amount of True damage <@autochess.gray> (affected by no. of stacks)</> and inflict <@ba.vup>Fear</> for 3 seconds when Invisible, or for <@ba.vup>10</> seconds after losing Invisibility

kazimierzShip.name: Kazimierz
kazimierzShip.desc:
On every Operator deployment, [Kazimierz] Operators gain <@ba.vup>+20%</> ATK until the battle ends <@autochess.gray>(limit affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Kazimierz] Operators on field> [Kazimierz] Operators blocking enemies deal <@ba.vup>120%</> of ATK as True Damage and inflict <@ba.vup>0.1</> seconds of Stun on nearby enemies every <@ba.vup>2</> seconds; otherwise dealing damage also deals extra <@ba.vup>30%</> ATK as True damage when not blocking an enemy

preciShip.name: Precision
preciShip.desc:
[Precision] Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Precision] Operators on field> Buff affects all [Precision] and Ranged Operators, and attacks ignore some <@ba.vup>DEF</> and <@ba.vup>RES</>

swiftShip.name: Swift
swiftShip.desc:
[Swift] Operators have a chance when their skill ends to immediately recover <@ba.vup>12</> SP <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>40</> stacks> All Operators have the same chance to recover <@ba.vup>15</> SP when their skill ends

skillfulShip.name: Agile
skillfulShip.desc:
[Agile] Operators and Operators in the 4 adjacent tiles around them gain increased<@ba.vup> ASPD</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>40</> stacks> Effect range increased to 8 tiles surrounding [Agile] Operators

arcaneShip.name: Arcane
arcaneShip.desc:
When [Arcane] Operators deal Arts damage to enemies, the target takes increased Arts damage <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</> for 3 seconds
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different Arcane Operators on field> Arcane Operators deal more damage to enemies with less than <@ba.vup>50%</> HP <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>

steadShip.name: Durable
steadShip.desc:
All Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>HP</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Durable] Operators on field> Whenever a non-[Durable] Operator takes damage, <@ba.vup>40%</> of that damage is <@ba.vup>split among</> all [Durable] Operators on field. [Durable] Operators taking damage inflict Arts Damage <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks, triggers up to once every 0.2 seconds)</> and <@ba.vup>40%</> Fragile for <@ba.vup>5</> seconds onto their attacker

deputShip.name: Aid
deputShip.desc:
All Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>DEF</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</> and reduced <@ba.vup>Redeployment Time</>
When Rest Phase ends, <@ba.vup>+2</> stacks to all active Alliances
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Aid] Operators on field> <@ba.vup>+4</> stacks instead

visiShip.name: Foresight
visiShip.desc:
<For every <@autochess.dgreen>10</> stacks> Gain <@ba.vup>+2</> Funds
<At <@autochess.dgreen>80</> stacks (first-time only)> Foresight Operators cost <@ba.vup>-1 Funds permanently</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>150</> stacks (first-time only)> Above effect changes to: All Dispatch Center Operators cost <@ba.vup>-1 Funds permanently</> ([Foresight] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

miraShip.name: Marvel
miraShip.desc:
On Dispatch Center refresh, there is a chance the next refresh will be <@ba.vup>free</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<Every <@autochess.dgreen>100</> stacks> Gain <@ba.vup>20</> Funds ([Marvel] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

investShip.name: Investor
investShip.desc:
Operators' 'When obtained' Attributes <@ba.vup>trigger twice</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>100</> stacks> 'When obtained' Attributes <@ba.vup>trigger 3 times</> instead ([Investor] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

raidShip.name: Raid
raidShip.desc:
If a [Raid] Operator's skill is ready or does not attack for <@ba.vup>10</> seconds, and has no enemies in their attack range, they will <@ba.vup>redeploy near a ground enemy,</> use their skill without losing SP, and gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> and <@ba.vup>HP</> during the skill duration <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>50</> stacks> All Operators gain <@ba.vup>+50</> ASPD

indomShip.name: Resilient
indomShip.desc:
When a <@ba.vup>Ground Operator</> is defeated, there is a chance they will <@ba.vup>immediately redeploy</><@autochess.gray> (affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Resilient] Operators on field> When defeated, <@ba.vup>Ground Operators</> grant <@ba.vup>+5 SP</> to all Operators on the field

maniShip.name: Harmony
maniShip.desc: When activated, <@ba.vup>+1 Operator count</> to all Core Alliances on field, and [Harmony] Operators also gain effects from these activated Alliances

emptyShip.name: Assist Operator
emptyShip.desc: All Operators take <@ba.vup>-20%</> Physical and Arts damage, Assist Operators deal <@ba.vup>120%</> damage; Elite Assist Operators deal <@ba.vup>140%</> damage

soloShip.name: Solo
soloShip.desc: <With 1 [Solo] Operator on field> The [Solo] Operator gains <@ba.vup>+60%</> ATK and HP; and <@ba.vup>+15</> SP on deployment (Effect disabled with 2 or more different [Solo] Operators on the field)

aceffect_band_23.effectDesc:
[HR Consultant] Every manual refresh becomes a special refresh: 2 copies of the same Operator will appear with one Frozen; obtain 1 Dispatch Module on Round 10

aceffect_band_24.effectDesc: [Completion Reward] For every 20 Funds spent, gain a random Operator from a Tier not exceeding the current Dispatch Center Level

aceffect_band_27.effectDesc:

<@ba.acrem><Commercial Packaging Plan> For every 8 Operators sold, obtain 1 non-Elite Operator from the same Alliance as the equipped Operator</>

aceffect_band_28.effectDesc:
[Heroes All Around] The first two manual refreshes in every round become a special refresh: This refresh will prioritize offering 1 Yan Operator
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some Yan Operators are missing</>

aceffect_band_29.effectDesc:
[Erudite and Versatile] When Dispatch Center reaches Lv. 2, 4, and 6, obtain 1 special refresh: This refresh will prioritize offering <Sargon> Operators
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Sargon> Operators are missing</>

aceffect_band_30.effectDesc:
[Talent Blind Box] Starting from Round 4, obtain 1 <Victoria> Operator every 2 rounds
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Victoria> Operators are missing</>

<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Kjerag> Operators are missing</>

<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Lateran> Operators are missing</>

<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Ægir> Operators are missing</>

constData.dailyMissionRule:
Obtain [Stronghold Credit] x<@acdm.award>200</> through the simulation, and you'll be able to collect a bonus [Stronghold Credit] x<@acdm.award>300</> at the completion screen.
*Rewards issued once per day. Rewards refresh daily at 04:00

mode_single_hard.name: Dire Simulation
mode_single_hard.desc: A simulation with very dangerous enemies
mode_single_hard.unlockText: Unlocks after completing Solo - [Perilous Simulation] 3 times

mode_multi_normal.name: Perilous Simulation
mode_multi_normal.unlockText: Unlocks after completing [Standard Simulation] with a team

mode_multi_hard.name: Dire Simulation
mode_multi_hard.desc: A simulation with very dangerous enemies
mode_multi_hard.unlockText: Unlocks after completing [Perilous Simulation] with a team 3 times

band_bldsk.bandDesc:
[Intensive Monitoring] When the battle starts, +2 Alliance Stacks to 1 random Operator of each different Tier on the field
In <Standard Simulation>, all Operators +30% ATK, DEF, and HP

band_amiya.bandDesc:
[Wills As One] When there are 2/3/4 different active Alliances, all Operators +15/30/50% ATK and HP respectively
In <Standard Simulation>, all Operators +30% ATK, DEF, and HP

band_duyaoy.bandDesc:
[Heroes All Around] The first two manual refreshes in every round become a special refresh: This refresh will prioritize offering 1 Yan Operator
In Standard Simulation, all Operators +30% ATK, DEF, and HP
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some Yan Operators are missing</>

band_sarkazb.bandDesc:
[Indestructible] Start with 45 Life Points
In <Standard Simulation>, all Operators +30% ATK, DEF, and HP

band_orchid.bandDesc: [HR Consultant] Every manual refresh becomes a special refresh: 2 copies of the same Operator will appear with one Frozen; obtain 1 Dispatch Module on Round 10: When equipped, refreshing will offer Operator(s) from the same Alliance as the equipped Operator

band_justin.bandDesc: [Private Equity Fund] Upon entering Rest Phase on Rounds 1, 4, 7, 10, obtain 1 Lucky Coin: Destroyed when equipped and grants 1-6 Funds

band_ermengard.bandDesc: [Phylactery Secret] First 2 Operators defeated in battle will be revived immediately!

band_lmlee.bandDesc: [Idle Teatime] Funds from Rounds 1 and 2 are temporarily held and released on Round 3; randomly obtain 1 Tier 2 Operator and 1 Tier 4 Operator during Round 3's Rest Phase

band_kirara.bandDesc: [Completion Reward] For every 20 Funds spent, gain a random Operator from a Tier not exceeding the current Dispatch Center Level

band_pepe.bandDesc:
[Erudite and Versatile] When Dispatch Center reaches Lv. 2, 4, and 6, obtain 1 special refresh: this refresh will prioritize offering <Sargon> Operators
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Sargon> Operators are missing</>

band_harold.bandDesc:
[Talent Blind Box] Starting from Round 4, obtain 1 <Victoria> Operator every 2 rounds
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Victoria> Operators are missing</>

band_sciurus.bandDesc:
[Snowfield's Gift] The first <Kjerag> Operator purchased every round costs 1 Funds
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Kjerag> Operators are missing</>

band_paganini.bandDesc:
[Customized Firearm] After spending a total of 55 Funds, obtain 1 Tier 4 or above Elite Laterano Operator
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Laterano> Operators are missing</>

band_clementia.bandDesc:
[Noble Sacrifice] When an <Ægir> Operator is defeated, grants Ægir Alliance stacks equivalent to that Operator's Tier
<@ba.vdown>Strategy may be flawed when some <Ægir> Operators are missing</>

band_emperor.bandDesc: [Express Dispatch] All allied Operators -50% Redeployment Time

band_mberry.bandDesc: [Experimental Med. Sticks] When the battle begins, all allied Operators in the rightmost column of the field gain the following effect: Every attack has a 20% chance to grant 1 Shield (max 1 stack)

band_humus.bandDesc: [Recycling] When a Ground Operator's skill ends, they grant 3 SP to 1 random Operator in the adjacent 4 tiles

band_quintus.bandDesc: [Unstable Element] In Round 3, obtain special equipment Mutated Cells: After the battle ends, equipped Operator changes to a random Operator 1 Tier higher (up to Tier 6)

band_zumama.bandDesc: [Machine Assistance] 1 'Double Lids' appears on all battlefields: Can perform long-ranged Arts attacks and inflicts Fragile on enemy targets (Can be upgraded!)

band_yu.bandDesc: [Slow Simmer] When Round 8 begins, if there is only 1 active Alliance, +40 stacks to it; otherwise +12 stacks to all active Alliances

band_doberm.bandDesc: [Extra Training!] Obtain 1 'Pointing Stick' special Arts every 2 rounds: When used, adds extra enemies to the field and grants extra funds if the battle is perfectly cleared on your own

band_cathy.bandDesc: [Targeted Drop] Whenever the Dispatch Center is upgraded, the shop offers 1 free Equipment with 3 options to choose from

band_malkie.bandDesc: [Commercial Packaging] Start with 1 Commercial Packaging Plan: For every 8 Operators sold, obtain 1 copy of the equipped Operator

band_qalaisa.bandDesc: [Scavenger Butterfly] When an allied Operator is defeated, other allied units on the field gain +20% ATK (Max 200%, and lasts until Operators are defeated or the battle ends)

band_chen.bandDesc: [Personal Power] High Ground Operators deal Weakness damage (When dealing Physical or Arts damage, change damage type depending on the target's DEF and RES)

band_damaztic.bandDesc: [Damazti Isomorphism] In Round 5, obtain Damazti Isomorph: When equipped together with certain other equipment, the equipped Operator is treated as a member of a specific Alliance

band_pith.bandDesc: [Top Student] In Round 1, gain 1 special Operator that can deal Nervous Impairment, Burn, or Necrosis. This Operator also belongs to the Harmony Alliance: +1 Operator count to some Alliances

band_dusk.bandDesc: [Painted into Reality] In Round 1, obtain Special Arts Dusk's Scroll: On use, can copy 1 Operator within use range (Includes that Operator's Elite status and carried Equipment)

band_cannot.bandDesc: [Compound Interest] Leftover Funds can be saved for the next round. When there are at least 5 Funds left, gain 1 extra Funds per round

band_ducklord.bandDesc: ['Mystery Customer'] From Round 5 onwards, some enemies you and your teammates encounter may be replaced with <Duck Lord>, <Gopnik>, <Crying Thief>, or <Fatty>. Defeating them (even during Unite Phases) will grant 1 Funds

yanShip.name: Yan
yanShip.desc:
[Yan] Operators' <@ba.vup>ATK</> increases <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</><With <@autochess.dgreen>
6</> different [Yan] Operators on field> At the start of battle, <@ba.vup>'Yan's Protection'</> is summoned with ATK and HP equal to 30% of the total ATK and HP of all [Yan] Operators at that moment. 'Yan's Protection' can use <@ba.vup>'Cleansing Flame'</>: attacks inflict a percentage of damage as Burn, and inflicts Elemental Fragility on surrounding enemies

sargonShip.name: Sargon
sargonShip.desc:
When any [Sargon] Operator activates a skill, all [Sargon] Operators temporarily gain increased <@ba.vup>ASPD</> (up to a limit) for a duration<@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Sargon] Operators on field> Skill activations will also cause all [Sargon] Operators to temporarily gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> (up to a limit) for the same duration

victoriaShip.name: Victoria
victoriaShip.desc:
[Victoria] Operators carrying equipment deal <@ba.vup>more damage</><@autochess.gray> (affected by no. of stacks)</>
<Every <@autochess.dgreen>25</> stacks> Obtain 1 random <@ba.vup>Victorian Hammer</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Victoria] Operators on field> All [Victoria] Operators carrying equipment gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</>

kjeragShip.name: Kjerag
kjeragShip.desc:
[Kjerag] Operators deal <@ba.vup>increased damage</>, and even more to <@ba.vup>Cold and Frozen</> enemies <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Kjerag] Operators on field> A chill gust blows on the battlefield every 25 seconds, inflicting Cold on enemies for a period of time (affected by no. of stacks)

lateranoShip.name: Laterano
lateranoShip.desc:
[Laterano] Operators gain <@ba.vup>ammo</> on skill activation <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Laterano] Operators on field> All [Laterano] Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> when any [Laterano] Operator spends 1 bullet

investShip.name: Investor
investShip.desc:
Operators' 'When obtained' Attributes <@ba.vup>trigger twice</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>70</> stacks> 'When obtained' Attributes <@ba.vup>trigger 3 times</> instead ([Investor] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

egirShip.name: Ægir
egirShip.desc:
[Ægir] Operators' <@ba.vup>HP</> increases <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
When the battle begins, [Ægir] Operators will <@ba.vup>devour</> the Operator on the tile in front of them, dealing <@ba.vdown>6000</> Physical damage to the Operator and gaining their <@ba.vup>base ATK</> and <@ba.vup>Block</>, while adding [Ægir] <@ba.vup>stacks</> equal to the devoured Operator's Tier
<With <@autochess.dgreen>5</> different [Ægir] Operators on the field> the first 2 defeated will immediately revive

maniShip.name: Harmony
maniShip.desc: The [Harmony] Alliance grants <@ba.vup>+1 Operator count</> to Core Alliances ([Yan], [Sargon], [Victoria], [Kjerag], [Laterano], and [Ægir]); [Harmony] Operators also gain effects from said activated Alliances

visiShip.name: Foresight
visiShip.desc:
<For every <@autochess.dgreen>10</> stacks added> gain <@ba.vup>+2</> Funds
<At <@autochess.dgreen>100</> stacks (first-time only)> Dispatch Center Operators <@ba.vup>cost 1 less Funds permanently</> ([Foresight] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

preciShip.name: Precision
preciShip.desc:
High Ground Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Precision] Operators on field> High Ground Operators' attacks ignore some <@ba.vup>DEF</> and <@ba.vup>RES</>, and attacks silence targets for 2 seconds

steadShip.name: Durable
steadShip.desc:
All Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>HP</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Durable] Operators on the field> Whenever a non-[Durable] Operator takes damage, <@ba.vup>40%</> of that damage is <@ba.vup>split among</> all [Durable] Operators on field

raidShip.name: Raid
raidShip.desc:
If a [Raid] Operator's skill is ready with no enemies in their attack range, they will <@ba.vup>redeploy near a ground enemy,</> use their skill, and gain increased <@ba.vup>ATK</> and <@ba.vup>HP</> during the skill duration <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>30</> stacks> All Operators <@ba.vup>-50%</> DP Cost

miraShip.name: Marvel
miraShip.desc:
On Dispatch Center refresh, there is a chance the next refresh will be <@ba.vup>free</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<Every <@autochess.dgreen>50</> stacks> Gain <@ba.vup>10</> Funds ([Marvel] Operators on Bench can also count toward activating this Alliance)

indomShip.name: Resilient
indomShip.desc:
When a Ground Operator is defeated, there is a chance they will <@ba.vup>immediately redeploy</><@autochess.gray> (affected by no. of stacks)</>
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Resilient] Operators on field> when defeated, Ground Operators grant <@ba.vup>+5 SP</> to all Operators on the field

swiftShip.name: Swift
swiftShip.desc:
[Swift] Operators have a chance when their skill ends to immediately recover <@ba.vup>10</> SP <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>40</> stacks> all Operators have the same chance to recover <@ba.vup>15</> SP when their skill ends

deputShip.name: Aid
deputShip.desc:
All Operators gain increased <@ba.vup>DEF</> <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</> and reduced <@ba.vup>Redeployment Time</>
When Rest Phase ends, <@ba.vup>+2</> stacks to all active Alliances
<With <@autochess.dgreen>3</> different [Aid] Operators on field> <@ba.vup>+4</> stacks instead

skillfulShip.name: Agile
skillfulShip.desc:
[Agile] Operators and Operators in the 8 adjacent tiles around them gain<@ba.vup>increased</> ASPD <@autochess.gray>(affected by no. of stacks)</>
<At <@autochess.dgreen>20</> stacks> First manual refresh every Rest Phase will <@ba.vup>lower equipment price to 1</> Funds

emptyShip.name: Assist Operator
emptyShip.desc: All Operators take <@ba.vup>-20%</> Physical and Arts damage, deal <@ba.vup>120%</> more damage; Elite Operators deal <@ba.vup>140%</> more damage

garrison_01_a.garrisonDesc: <In battle> Deals Weakness damage (changes damage type to either Physical or Arts depending on the target's DEF and RES)
garrison_01_a.description: <In battle> Deals Weakness damage (changes damage type to either Physical or Arts depending on the target's DEF and RES)

garrison_05_a.garrisonDesc: For every 3 stacks added to [Kjerag] or [Swift] Alliances, this Operator gains <@ba.vup>+1%</> ATK
garrison_05_a.description: For every 3 stacks added to [Kjerag] or [Swift] Alliances, this Operator gains <@ba.vup>+1%</> ATK

garrison_06_a.garrisonDesc: <When in battle> If Flowing Shape is deployed, partly copies the stats of the leftmost Operator on Bench
garrison_06_a.description: <When in battle> If Flowing Shape is deployed, partly copies the stats of the leftmost Operator on Bench

garrison_07_a.garrisonDesc: For every 3 stacks added to [Ægir] or [Swift] Alliances, this Operator gains <@ba.vup>+1%</> ATK
garrison_07_a.description: For every 3 stacks added to [Ægir] or [Swift] Alliances, this Operator gains <@ba.vup>+1%</> ATK

rule: To mine, use the beacon launcher to deploy a beacon into the mining area. The location marked by the beacon will be available for mining.

Possible types of ore include: <color=#b91600>Originium Crude Ore</color>, <color=#b91600>Originium Ore</color>, <color=#b91600>Originium Vein</color>. The locations of the Veins are marked on the map. <color=#b91600>Originium Crude Ore</color> is worth <color=#b91600>300</color> Orundums, <color=#b91600>Originium Vein</color> is worth <color=#b91600>1800</color> Orundums, and <color=#b91600>Originium Ore</color>'s value varies between <color=#b91600>Originium Crude Ore</color> and <color=#b91600>Originium Vein</color>, the exact value of which will be shown after it has been processed.
If the beacon fails to reach a Vein, the chance to encounter an <color=#b91600>Originium Vein</color> will <color=#b91600>increase</color> on the next attempt.
The beacon launcher can only be used <color=#b91600>once</color> a day, and its usage permit will reset at <color=#b91600>04:00</color> every day.

If no <color=#b91600>Originium Veins</color> are found before the access period ends, professionals will be there to guide the Rhodes Island prospecting team to the location of an <color=#b91600>Originium Vein</color> on the <color=#b91600>last day</color>.
Solo mining and theft are strictly prohibited and all legal avenues will be pursued in such cases.
Cautus Valley Mining Area reserves the right to change these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.

act5mine.ruleText:
To start mining, use a beacon launcher outside the mine to deploy a beacon. The location where the beacon lands will be available for mining.

Possible types of ore include: <color=#ff4e4e>Originium Crude Ore</color>, <color=#ff4e4e>Originium Ore</color>, and <color=#ff4e4e>Originium Vein</color>. The locations of the Veins are marked on the map. <color=#ff4e4e>Crude Ore</color> is worth <color=#ff4e4e>400</color> Orundum, <color=#ff4e4e>Vein</color> is worth <color=#ff4e4e>1,000</color> Orundum, and <color=#ff4e4e>Originium Ore</color>'s value varies between <color=#ff4e4e>Crude Ore</color> and <color=#ff4e4e>Vein</color>, the exact value of which will be shown after it has been processed.

The locations of the Veins in this mining area are marked on the map, and three Vein signals will immediately be marked on the map when mining begins. 
If the beacon fails to reach a Vein, <color=#ff4e4e>two</color> additional Vein signals will be marked on the map.
If the beacon reaches a Vein, that Vein will <color=#ff4e4e>disappear</color> afterwards. (However, if the Vein signal is the only one remaining on the map, it <color=#ff4e4e>will not disappear</color> after mining.)

The beacon launcher can only be used <color=#ff4e4e>once</color> a day, and its usage permit will renewed at <color=#ff4e4e>04:00</color> every day.

The mining period will be split into three phases:<color=#ff4e4e>Day 1 to 5</color>, <color=#ff4e4e>Day 6 to 10</color>, <color=#ff4e4e>Day 11 to 14</color>.

Within each phase, if no Veins are found before the last day of the phase, Callipers Mines personnel will guide the Rhodes Island prospecting team to  a Vein on the last day, which are the 5th, 10th or 14th day.

Unauthorized mining is strictly prohibited and will be deemed theft, subject to severe penalties.
Callipers Mines reserves the right to change these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.

act1blessing_festival_1_1.charBlessing: Doctor, a little more to the right, yes, a little more—careful! Phew. You almost tripped there. Leave the rest to me. Dinner's almost ready and you're in a hurry, yes? Wait, is this your work? Why does this look like me? You thought a paper cutout of me summoning thunder would ward off evil and usher in prosperity? Ahem, well, it's a special occasion, so I'll let it slide this time.

act1blessing_festival_1_2.charBlessing: Doctor, I didn't see you at morning practice today. Isn't it a pity to abandon your ten-day streak? You deserve a break, you say? Haha, Zuo Le used to say that when we were kids. Though the Grandmaster seems to have prepared gift envelopes today... He should still be in the Training Room, so you'd better go right away. Oh, and this is for you. Glassy-Sweet Rice Fritters—yes, the brand you like.

act1blessing_festival_1_3.charBlessing: Cleaning the floors isn't much different than treating water: practice makes perfect. You want to join our cleaning efforts, Doctor? Great, then—Huh? You even brought your own broom? 'This is Engineering's specially modified full-auto Yanese Grand Cleaning broom that's sure to sweep out both misfortune and dirt.'—Eh? Is it really just a broom?

act1blessing_festival_2_1.charBlessing: Every beginning comes with a new restart. The masses often anticipate renewal, but is that always a guarantee in this realm? For example, take the one you're concerned about—Oh? You're so sure you'll find her yet again? Hmph... Why not have a seat, and tell me about your plan. Hm... Dumplings from Savors at Yu's? We can eat first before continuing our discussion? Hmph, you do remind me of a certain someone.

act1blessing_festival_2_2.charBlessing: Greetings, Doctor. I was just heading over to Medical. Breaks are hard to come by, but routine checkups are still necessary. She used to have that habit too. Of course we can go together. Everyone always seems to look forward to meeting you. Before... I seem to recall following you both around as you did your greetings.

act1blessing_festival_2_3.charBlessing: Doctor, are you in? There's a lantern display happening downtown, and Uncle Lee was wondering if you'd like to join us—Aak? What are you doing here? You guys... what's with this black hotpot concoction?! A feast for us...? Doctor, I appreciate your kindness, but I think you'd best leave the cooking to Uncle Lee and Hung.

act1blessing_festival_3_1.charBlessing: We made dumplings and tangyuan! Here, try some. Why not just one or the other? Well, y'see—The guys were debating which is the best Yanese dish for celebrations, and deciding on one would've started a brawl in the Training Room. What's wrong?! Bit down on something hard in the dumpling? Oh, a coin! My sis said getting one means a prosperous future for you!

act1blessing_festival_3_2.charBlessing: Gimme your hand! Here—it's yummy maiyatang I made with everyone in Dahuang! Even Big Buffalo and Shu couldn't help but nom on a few themselves! Remember to save some for Amiya too, okay? Huh? You've got presents for me too? Victorian Gumdrops and a lava cake! Hehe, thanks, Wisehead! Your generosity's gonna pay off, I'm sure!

act1blessing_festival_3_3.charBlessing: Hold on. What's the rush? On your way to the sky lanterns? Wait up! Take this. What's wrong? Does the design not impress you—You want to know why I made this? Well, I'm not one for festivities... but the hopes and dreams I've seen over the years have swayed me a little. Worry not, the craftsmanship is excellent. I'm sure it'll shine the brightest and longest!

act1blessing_festival_4_1.charBlessing: Day ten, I should leave soon. So, Doctor, is it the people you are reluctant to part with, or the vestiges of your vacation days? Just kidding. In olden times, people once measured the distance of 'reunion' with their footsteps. Things became much simpler once the Chidao highways were built, yet the growth we once yearned for has only made reunion feel further out of reach. But as long as you need me, I'll return no matter how far I am.

act1blessing_festival_4_2.charBlessing: Doctor, what did you have for dinner today? Braised fin, stewed fowl... Wait, did you actually memorize the entire menu? Oh, you heard about a Yanese custom to write an essay after a big reunion dinner? Haha, I see, I see! Though, I'm sure it's more about remembering the warmth of sharing those dishes than their names. Let's have a meal together some time! I'll definitely invite my teacher over too!

act1blessing_festival_4_3.charBlessing: You got the best fortune result in one try? That's definitely a good sign, Doctor! Right, I went home to the escort association, and they told me to give you this 'safe travels' amulet. It's made of peach wood and blessed by a master in Shangshu. He's a mysterious man who's hard to meet. Wait, isn't that gentleman over there with the sunglasses...?

act1blessing_festival_1_1.charBlessing:
In the kitchen at this hour, Doctor? Feeling peckish?
Grab a bowl and I'll make something for you... almost done. This is the last dish.
You'll have a meal to remember tonight!

act1blessing_festival_1_2.charBlessing:
Here about the party?
Don't worry, I'll be there. I promised the kids I'd perform a sword dance for them.
Just give me a few minutes. You can wait with me if you want to.
What am I waiting for? There it is. Snow.

act1blessing_festival_1_3.charBlessing:
Fancy a scalecis?
Lungmen's night market stays open now.
You're looking for a place to watch the fireworks? Give me a moment... let me close the stall first.
There's a fine place by the river. I'll take you there.

act1blessing_festival_2_1.charBlessing:
It's a brand new day.
A new day means a fresh start, but we shouldn't forget that the seeds for that start were sown before.
So how have things been, Doctor? Did your wishes come true? Any regrets?
Looks like you have a lot to say. Just a moment—I'll prepare a few dishes, then we can sit down and take our time.

act1blessing_festival_2_2.charBlessing:
Let me stay here for a while, boss.
Hung and Waai Fu dragged me along to visit all the neighbors. I slipped out at the first opportunity.
What? There's something written on my back?
'Greetings, Doctor!—Lee's Detective Agency'... Ding nei goh fai! They tricked me!

act1blessing_festival_2_3.charBlessing:
Greetings, Doctor! May my luck rub off on you!
You heard about Nian's new film, right? Guess what—I'm in it!
The money's not important. What's important is the feeling of being in the shoot!
Speaking of the shoot, it's about to start soon, and I've gotta go! Feel free to visit!

act1blessing_festival_3_1.charBlessing:
Hello, Doctor! I brought a whole truckload of gifts from the Tianshi Bureau. It's some of the best stuff, and I guarantee they'll taste great!
Can't stay long. I've got to go back—What's with that smile on your face?
Oh... those crates are gifts from Rhodes Island to the Tianshi Bureau? Looks like we were thinking the same thing!
I'll pick them up right now and bring them back!

act1blessing_festival_3_2.charBlessing:
According to Yanese tradition, cleaning helps sweep bad luck out the door.
I don't really believe in that stuff, but cleaning is good training for both body and mind, so I do it anyway.
What's that pose, Doctor? Did you want to spar with me?
You got to hold your broom like this... ahem. Let's keep sweeping.

act1blessing_festival_3_3.charBlessing:
Greetings, sir. What's the situation?
I'll deal with it immediately—What? You wanted guidance on how to launch fireworks safely?
Sure! Just watch my movements and keep a safe distance. Light the fuse, then immediately pull back—

act1blessing_festival_4_1.charBlessing:
Have a seat, Doctor. You said you wanted to try some traditional Yanese snacks?
You came to the right person.
Here are some of the most famous dishes. How about I explain their history before you tuck in?
This dish is said to have originated centuries ago, when the Lung paid a secret visit to the people...

act1blessing_festival_4_2.charBlessing:
Doctor? Yes, I'm getting ready to leave now.
There are a lot of letters to deliver. I was glad to have the chance to spend these last few days on Rhodes Island and take in the fresh air.
Oh, and thanks for teaching me those camera tricks. I'll take even better landscape videos on this trip, and show them to you when I get back!

act1blessing_festival_4_3.charBlessing:
Please, Doctor, don't call me 'Mister' Bison. I still have much to learn from you. What's that? Gift packets? So that's what you're here for...
That's something that an employer gives their employee, though, and you're my boss here on Rhodes Island... Shouldn't I be getting one from you?

act1blessing_festival_1_1.charBlessing: Want to sit a while and have something to eat? I'm cooking... You say it's rare that I'm not looking for peace and quiet? Well, it's not such a bad thing to have one day each year for gatherings and festivities. Keeps the warmth in the air, you know.

act1blessing_festival_1_2.charBlessing: There you are, Doctor! I was thinking about divining your fortune for the new year. You want to know about the past? Ah, but each person's past is their own to discover. Here, have some walnuts, and don't worry too much about it.

act1blessing_festival_1_3.charBlessing: Of course I know there's a festival going on. How could I miss all that noise and commotion... Clear out the old? Tradition? What a contradiction. Why set a fixed date every year, if you really want to clear out the old? A new chapter writes itself, whenever inspiration comes.

act1blessing_festival_2_1.charBlessing: I worked hard on these fireworks. They're filled with my special chili powder, guaranteed to give everyone a real jolt! I'll let you do the honors of lighting them, Doctor.

act1blessing_festival_2_2.charBlessing: Do you have any ink with you? My tail's feeling creative now that I've had a drink or two. Well, I suppose I can write with this liquor. Only fitting that a poem inspired by wine would fill one's senses with the same fragrance.

act1blessing_festival_2_3.charBlessing: No, no, don't worry about it, I'll get it cleaned up in a moment. Want to sit a while? I'll make a dish or two... No, don't worry, I'm not tired at all. Can't celebrate the new year without cleaning up, after all.

act1blessing_festival_3_1.charBlessing: Still thinking about arrangements for the festival? Why don't we hold a big banquet for everyone on Rhodes Island? I know a restaurant that can hold all of us!

act1blessing_festival_3_2.charBlessing: Happy New Year! I haven't forgotten what you've done for me, and I've procured two crates of superb equipment for you. I guarantee you won't be disappointed!

act1blessing_festival_3_3.charBlessing: Yes, this is the report I have to hand in after the festival. Everyone says today is the day to pray to the God of Wealth, but wealth will mean so much more if I get my research out of the way... You'll help me with the experiments? Thank you so much!

act1blessing_festival_4_1.charBlessing: Holidays always feel so short. If you're lacking in motivation to get back to work, feel free to train with me in the morning. Maybe it'll give you a boost of energy.

act1blessing_festival_4_2.charBlessing: How did you get yourself so tired? Holidays are supposed to be for rest and recuperation... No, no, no, you're going to REST today. I don't want to have to give you electric shocks to wake you up tomorrow.

act1blessing_festival_4_3.charBlessing: Swire brought a whole brigade to Lungmen for dinner? She likes her parties big, doesn't she? How about we get something to eat together too, if you have the time? Just a little snack. Can't work on an empty stomach.

words.text: Hello hello, welcome all new faces and welcome back old faces~
I'm just hiding—no, I'm the Ultimate Beautiful Girl runaway, Streamer U!
Hello, viewers! Long time no see, did you miss me?
If you did, make sure to tune in to my streams~
The Ultimate Beautiful Girl will bring you around this great land without even leaving your home!
And it's not just the surface either, I've even been underground!
Wow, so many new viewers! Thank you all so much for the gifts...ah, I don't want people gifting me stuff please!
Nooooooooooo! I really don't need them! Please don't get the wrong idea everyone! Just your comments and praises are already enough~
Don't gift me presents, alright! Okay, everyone! Take a look at these, I've prepared some good stuff for all of you today!
Um...Let me see which one was it...
Seems like we have some new friends, welcome, welcome! I'm the Ultimate Beautiful Girl~
This is Ur Daily Terra Photo Parade livestream~
In alllll the places I've been to, this set of photos are the finest shots I've gotten, they're super neat~
Just a moment while I find them, okay? Um...let me see...
Hehe, thank you for the support my friends~
Now then! Take a look at the footage I've so meticulously prepared for you all——
'The first step is to build the confidence to renege your debts, to believe that you can shake off the debt collectors hot on your tail...'
Ah, sorry! That's the wrong one! I'll show you guys the real stuff right away!
Hello all to our new friends~ welcome to the Daily Terra Photo Parade~
I'll you guys something, I saw something super duper hyper interesting when I went out for fun!
I saw *beep* doing *beeeep* and *beeeeeep* I was dying from laughter lololol
Hello? Can you hear me? *beep* Can you still not hear me?
What's going on? I'll just grab some photos for everyone to see!
I'm Streamer U, okay! Don't mistake me for somebody else, I don't know who's the unlucky TV host you're talking about!
Pay attention! This is! The Ultimate Beautiful Girl!
Daily wonders on Terra, non-stop~ And next, Streamer U will show you—
Um? Let me see which one was it...
Uh...I feel like everyone here isn't lively enough...should I...sing a song?
Yahoo——Hey! Summer!! The sun——*cough**cough**cough*
I'm sorry everyone, my voice is at its limit, I'll make sure to practice more!
*sigh* I think I better not sing anymore and just show you photos, alright.
Um...Let me see which one was it...
Huh? Wait, someone's calling me...
What? You threw out my package?? What's wrong with your company?! I want to make a complaint! Hello??
How could they...haha...sorry for the weird hiccup earlier, let's continue the stream.
Oh, right, I need to show this to everyone...uh...which one is it...
Take a look at this photo, everyone! Doesn't it look very...artistic?
I'm not flattering myself, this is all thanks to my eyes that let me discover beauty from ordinary things!
Look at this, everyone! I'm super confident of this one!
This scenery, these subjects, this lighting, isn't there a certain beauty about it?
Yikes, I gave myself a scare, I did say I'll definitely bring the goods!
This footage may seem mediocre, but actually, actually...there's a hidden message, and the concept is super deep, so it lingers in your mind!
Have a look at what I've painstakingly prepared for everyone, this photo is titled...mediocre...bleh.
However! Life is often just like this photo, returning to one's most natural state is the highest level of enlightenment you can attain!
Heheh, behold, my masterful artistic sense!
Even the most ordinary object can move people to tears with a little touch of my empathy generating ingenuity!
Wow! Look at this, guys! This is when I was at...at...where was I...
No, this is a, um, this is just way too good a photo, right? Hahaha...
Look at this guy, he seems like a normal dude, but in actuality...actually, he's also...boring?
Who said that—no, don't leave me guys! I'm just lowering your guard before I stun you all with my skills!
When did I even take this, this is such an ugly—no,no,no, what I mean is—!
My footage kinda sucks, but it's full of intrigue...how exactly, you ask—hahaha...
If you look closely, this photo is actually extremely exquisite...
*ahem* Exquisite how, exactly...? Uh, um, forget it, let's change the topic, 'kay?
It's here, everyone! My super amazing photo—oh no, my hand slipped!
Wait, don't leave the stream!
I swear I won't slip up next time, and I'll bring you guys some real good stuff!
Don't focus on their height difference, but rather their fighting back and forth—this is the power of Durin-style martial arts!
Look at that solid posture, he's about to hit that Archosauria's knee! Knee smashing boxing technique!
This is a...a Durin-made robot surfing instructor! You guys don't believe me? It really is a surfing instructor, trust me!
Look at the towel on its head, and the surfboard in its hand, and even that whistle on its neck! Virtually perfect except for the fact it can't float!
As for how they teach you surfing—if you can't they'll just give you a punch until you do!
To be honest, I still haven't figured out what this thing even is. I feel like it's a robot for logging...
But why would a logging robot be equipped with a cannon? All I can say is...maybe...
Maybe it's because the trees in Acahualla are too thick, so you need to use a cannon...?
Of all the weird liberi Streamer U has seen, this is number one.
It's not as rage-inducing as no.2, but it's also a pain in the ass to deal with him scuttling around, especially in places where he shouldn't even be.

The weirdest thing though, is that the fire on him has been burning for so long, and yet his feathers don't burn up and turn him bald. And after the fire dies, he just looks the same. It's so strange.
That's right, Acahualla doesn't only have Archosauria and Durin, but also Perro and mushrooms.
It's said that Acahualla mushrooms shouldn't be eaten willy-nilly. Many of them are poisonous, so eating one will not only turn your insides upside down, and you'll even see a bunch of illusory guys.
I actually tried it once myself, and I saw myself surrounded by eight burly men, each holding a bank's payment reminder!
The inhabitants of Acahualla often bicker over the thickness of their tails, and sometimes get into fights over it, which is also a part of their custom.
I hear rumors of their revered spiritual leader being part of the thick tail faction, and they're even planning of erecting a statue with her tail being thicker than the statue's base.
What, my tail? Don't ask such a useless question! It's classified information!
Okay, another weird robot from the Durin...This is a 'Waker-Upper', yup, it sprays water on a drunkard to sober them up.
This thing can adjust the power of its water cannon according to how drunk the target is. The weakest level is called 'Misty Drizzle Spray' and the strongest is 'Blasts Your Head Off In One Shot'.
Injure...? Hahaha, how could that happen? It's cutting edge technology from the Durins, of course it's safe!
Don't be fooled by the Durin's love of brewing spirits and drinking, their alcohol tolerance is actually pretty bad.
When I had no money to eat...to eat a fancy meal I mean, I made a bet with the Durins, that if I could drink more mead than them, they'd have to treat me to a week's worth of bento boxes!
I lost to their president in the end, but there were already ten plus Durins on the ground then, haha!
Even though the Durins you've all been seeing always seem to be drunk, they do sober up occasionally.
When sober they dabble in science and art, but in my honest opinion, their artistic sense when sober isn't as good as when they're completely sloshed...
Huh? A popup window? Reminder? Please take note to promote healthy living habits?
*ahem* That's right! Drinking is bad for your health, and it's never too late to give up alcohol! This is a pact between us, let's start abstaining from today!
What a pair of good friends, that durin hasn't even take a single hit!
Isn't this one of those surfing instructors from Zeruertza that can't float? Why is it here?
I don't know their name, but it's so big and ugly!
Would the ugly thing run fast if a fire lit behind it?
That mushroom looks delicious, it's got to be honey-biscuit flavored...wait, what am I thinking?
Tail thickness? I've never worried about my tail before.
Who ever said this thing could even sober up people? I think that person is the real drunk.
I'm not worried about those three passengers, but what if the driver is also drunk...no way, right.
H-he fell into the pit......is he snoring? Taking a nap in the pit?!
Wow~! So today is the birthday of our lovely viewer 'Regular Part-Timer'? Thank you for the support~
I'll sing you a birthday song! I wish you a—
Wait, you only earned 5 LMD today?
What? The Durin that fell into the pit is in the stream chat right now?
Sorry for asking, but I'm super curious as to how you even crawled out...
'If you don't watch Streamer U I'll cry...' Wow! Thank you for being my fan!
This username...reminds me of a mod's side account—
Wait, that's not it! Streamer U does her best everyday, of course~
You want me to stream... Barrage Fortress...? What is that? A game?
I've never heard of this game before, but I'll definitely try it out next time, I promise~
Special effects? No, this is all natural! I don't even know what that is! Besides, I've never lied to you guys before, right?
I just happened to take a photo of this! I'm telling the truth!
Um, haha, let's not overstep boundaries now, if you want to advertise something you should be paying me...
Wait, no! *ahem* There's no place for random ads here!
Of course, if you're talking about collabs, we can always discuss...
Hahaha! Well, it's me after all, so of course my foundation skills are on point!
*sigh* If only Wrankwood would just notice my talents and give me an acting career...
Oh! Thank you KiraStaraKira for your support~
I heard about a super difficult accomplishment you can get from a treasure chest, I'll try to find it tomorrow!
Hey, mister sexyman, you've said this in my chat for three days straight!
Send it one more time and I'll block you, I'm not giving you any more chances even if you're handsome!
Okay, okay! Actually, Click-sensei helped me get these plushies from a second hand shop—
I'll stop pretending! They're from a second hand store! So what if they're second hand! Second hand plushies are still cute as hell!
Although...e-even though my financial situation is pretty shaky, I still try my best to coordinate a good fit!
Never mind, I'll just take it as a compliment, *sob*...
Hey friend, if you wanna request a song... you need to do it in the right format.
And the song request...no, it's great you're willing to give me money, so, but, um...
Also, you don't have to use a super chat to request a song!
Huh? IZUMIKun? Have we met before?
That's nonsense, I did go to Dossoles once, but not as a TV host or anything, I have no idea what you're talking about, haha.
Thank you, Fjera~ What an elegant name! Just hearing it makes me feel at ease~
It feels just like... I'm talking to an older sister!
How adults dream...huh, what do you mean? I'm wide awake?
Keeper...of the Cradle? Are you a medic that can help people to sleep well?
That's great, can you recommend me some methods to try out?
Oh my gosh...this is the most heartwarming thing I've seen today!
Upvoted! Please pay attention to your work-life balance, everyone! I hope all of you get to leave work on time!
Where's the power supply...where's the cable end...oh, got it.
So, uh, well, my friends, since there's nothing to talk about, the stream...
I'll end the stream here for today?
Huh? Where did all my footage go? How am I supposed to stream without it?
Oh, I got it! It has to be a terminal failure! I'll go call the repairman and be back ASAP!
I heard that this dude's number one on the Lungmen finball stall rankings! But he seems to be selling live fins today instead.
But you know, there is a legend in Lungmen: there's a man who stands at the apex of power with eyes so sharp they could cut you in half, and countless fins have died under his knife.
If he's selling finballs, all is calm; but if he's selling live fins, then it means something is about to happen......that's what I heard at least!
He looks like an old rickety geezer at first sight, doesn't he? He's actually the most famous person in Lungmen!
The superficial reason for his popularity is that for the past several decades, you'll see him out on a stroll every day rain or shine!
And the true reason is that whenever he goes on a stroll he raps some rhymes too!
This is a popular idol I happened to meet while I was in Lungmen, I hear her album's a best seller there!
What? Who's more popular between the both of us?
Hey, don't try to start a war here, we're more like parallel lines on different tracks!
This...I guess this is one of the shoddier areas in Lungmen, ahaha...
But speaking of which, for some reason...these thugs can somehow get themselves dead drunk and yet still know right from wrong, like they're afraid of offending someone.
But Lungmen's bosses spare no mercy for people who try to get a free lunch, this I've experienced first-hand, I mean, saw first hand!
If you think she's handsome, type 'handsome' in chat!
I asked around before, this is an employee of the L.G.D., and apparently they've been working there for real long.
Who, who said her weapon looks like an electric fan? I see you haven't seen her when she's truly angry—well, I haven't either, hehe.
Of all the weird liberi Streamer U has seen, this is number two.
I've seen him in a rush with other people before out on the streets, he runs as fast as No.1, and I couldn't even make him stop.
But what he says really makes you want to beat him up, if he didn't have a bodyguard beside him, he could probably run from Yan to Sargon in a day.
The bodyguard of Weird Liberi no.2, a big Ursus guy. I've seen him punch the living daylights outta people...super scary.
I feel like a punch from him can probably send you flying from the end of a street to another.
However! Don't you think his fur looks so fluffy and cute? Anyone want to rub his fluffy belly? Anyone? Surely someone else does too, yeah?!
This is...I don't know how to explain it, but I'm feeling some kind of secret between these two drones that can't be shared at any costs!
It looks kinda romantic, but if you look at it the other way, maybe they're...um...under the control of their masters and exchanging secret info!
And if you look at the drones' big bellies, it seems like there's something sus in there...what if it's chili oil?! Whoever gets bombed by them is spicy minced meat!
*ahem* So, my friends, have you ever seen a flying mirror before? It's round in shape, made of copper, and virtually indestructible...
I'm not faking it! I really don't know what this is! Why is this copper mirror flying in mid-air, I don't get it at all! Someone answer meeee!
What? You have to hit it thirty times to break it? Have you done that before? That's great, let's talk about it more—you're busy? Were you just pulling my leg?!
He's fast with his knife, skilled in kung fu, and such cold eyes he has!
When I see an old person crossing the road, I can't help but think of assisting them... I'm such a good person.
I want to be an idol too! Why haven't I been scouted by a manager yet...*sob*
The always drunk Durins look slightly cuter than this guy.
This lady is so handsome! And so tall...could she actually be a handsome guy with long hair?
What's with all the weird Liberi around here lately!
I don't care if I get punched, I still want to rub his fluffy belly! Just once!
The things attached look like they're about to drop.
What did I even snap a photo of? Paranormal activity?
*Sigh* I lived such a carefree live back when I was still just a clueless lass in Dossoles.
I want to watch a boat race again—I'll refrain from steering a boat myself though. The one time I had fun on a boat, I dropped so much money just for a ticket...

And then the pool I was in started draining all its water, and the staff said it was a routine maintenance...they even said my boat was the first one to be stranded ever since they opened their business!
Where's that guy that was calling himself handsome earlier? Show yourself—Oh, never mind, he's actually pretty handsome...
But! This hottie here that I forgot the name of, I still have an account to settle with him—I mean some of the fault lies with me, so I can't completely blame him...
Ahhh! Enough about him! I'll never see him again anyway! The moment I think about that face I get so mad!
This little girl is the younger sister of that hateful blond hottie. I didn't believe they were related before I saw a photo of them mixing drinks together.
They're family, but the gap in their personalities is really worlds apart.
The little sister is a hard working farmer and using her scythe to earn money, while the older brother just loafs around, it's honestly insane!
This guy ultimately got fished up with a net, he was sputtering a ton of water and even passed out, but was fortunately in no real danger.
There are people who can dive as good as those slippery little fins, and there are dudes like this that don't swim too good, and became a dockworker just to put food on the table.
Can I swim? Hey, I had the Dossoles freestyle 500 metres category...well, I was invited to award the prize for that, ahaha.
To anyone and everyone who goes to Dossoles for a holiday, make sure to be wary of pickpockets! They'll steal anything they can!
From wallets to speedboats, even a friend of mine with a crush got their heart stolen!
Wuh? 'You mean yourself right?' Hey, my relationship experience is still a big empty space, okay!
I won't hide it from you guys, but I repelled some ruffians myself before.
One day I ran into two groups of foreigners besieging a restaurant in Dossoles in unison, saying their food was completely inedible.
I took a look, and it was just macaroni in tomato broth with scrambled eggs, and espresso-braised slices of meat. I asked the boss for a serving each, and finished the entire thing.
The two groups were extremely impressed by me. They must have been dazzled and intimidated by my charisma, and soon walked away.
You can sometimes find unexpected surprises on the boats in Dossoles, like a pot of cactus growing like crazy in a cactus box or something.
Sometimes you'll see unmanned transport vessels malfunctioning and end up being washed ashore. If there's no eyes on them, the contents disappear in the blink of an eye.
The only exception would be the Dossoles tourist badges, I once saw a small pile one early afternoon, but in a few hours it had already become a mountain.
These guys are packed so tightly like a flock of liberi, doesn't it look a little scary?
When I had just arrived in Dossoles, I thought they were part of some secret specialist forces, but I was just gravely mistaken.

act6fun_01.description:
That dastardly Rhodes Island wants to keep Reunion trapped in Chernobog and bury us along with it! Well, not on our watch!
<color=#ed5016><Soldier></color> Feels like kindred spirits with the Doctor because their hoods sort of resemble each other.
<@lv.item><Heat Pump Passage></> Periodically deals massive damage to any units on it.
act6fun_01.npcDialogText: 'You want to know all about Reunion? Just watch, Doctor. We'll show you with our actions.'

act6fun_02.description:
Rhodes Island has the Chief of Lungmen under their thumb, and is trying to crash Lungmen into Chernobog! We have to stop their insane plot.
<color=#ed5016><Wraith></color> Learned to appreciate his own skills more after the Doctor joined, and is raring to go.
act6fun_02.npcDialogText: 'Is it true, Doctor? Once we finish this battle, we can go to school, and learn more advanced skills? Hah—I'll have to give it a try then!'

act6fun_03.description:
We thwarted Rhodes Island's wicked plan, but they won't let us go quietly. Lead us out of the barrens, Doctor!
<color=#ed5016><Sarkaz Lancer></color> Doesn't trust the Doctor, but is willing to follow orders to give Reunion a future.
<@lv.item><Stun Generator></> Can be activated by enemies to damage and stun your units nearby.
<@lv.item><Roadblock></> Blocks your units' route, and can be attacked and destroyed.
act6fun_03.npcDialogText: 'Hmph, I'll watch over you in Talulah's stead. One wrong move, and I'm throwing you off a mountain.'

act6fun_04.description:
The sinister Rhodes Island wants to occupy Chernobog! We have to seize control of it before they do, for the civilians' sake!
<color=#ed5016><Soldier></color> Seeing the Doctor in action made him want to come up with awesome strategies too, so he's been learning to read.
<@lv.item><Roadblock></> Blocks your units' route, and can be attacked and destroyed.
act6fun_04.npcDialogText: 'I kinda get what you're saying, Doctor. We don't pick up weapons to kill, but so we Infected can live with our heads held tall.'

act6fun_05.description:
Duck Lord has taken something valuable from the treasury of Rhodes Island's headquarters, Kazdel, and plans to give it to Reunion as a gift. But there's one problem—how will he escape?
<color=#ed5016><Duck Lord></color> After witnessing the Doctor issuing commands, he decided to invest in Reunion. He plans to send a great gift as a show of sincerity.
act6fun_05.npcDialogText: 'I'm curious, Doctor. How much would it cost to buy your knowledge and vision?'

act6fun_06.description:
The Doctor decides to raise chaos in the slums of Kazdel to support the Duck Lord, and a spy proactively takes on the task—
<color=#ed5016><Scrap Assembler></color> This Kazdel resident and Reunion spy volunteers to enter battle for the cause.
act6fun_06.npcDialogText: 'I can't just sit back and watch as Kazdel bends its knee to Rhodes Island. So tell me, Doctor, what should I do?'

act6fun_07.description:
Rhodes Island and Ursus are up to something. We'll have to sneak past layers of security and steal their plans. Make the call, Doctor.
<color=#ed5016><Ursus Civilian></color> Wanders the wastes trying to avoid the Patrol Unit, extremely timid.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Units who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
act6fun_07.npcDialogText: 'You saved me, Doctor, and it's time I repaid you. Relax, they'll never suspect a nobody like me—'

act6fun_08.description:
Break through Rhodes Island's blockade, and reach the depths of the nest... something awaits you there.
<color=#ed5016><Basin Sea Reaper></color> Seems to have been attracted by the Doctor, and has come onto land from the deep sea.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Units who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
<@lv.rem>In this stage, you can summon allied units by going near red incursion points.</>
act6fun_08.npcDialogText: (Squirming) (Screaming) (Slithering in the dark) (Trying to bring you into the sea)

act6fun_s01.description:
A masterless mecha awakens from its slumber, intent on demolishing everything it sees. Uh, how about we let Rhodes Island enjoy this particular blessing?
<color=#ed5016><The Last Steam Knight></color> He seems grumpy after waking up, and we might be able to use this.
<@lv.item><Roadblock></> Blocks your units' route, and can be attacked and destroyed.

act6fun_s02.description:
He willingly entrusts his life to the Doctor in order to rescue the imperiled civilians. For Reunion, he is willing to give everything.
<color=#ed5016><Sarkaz Lancer></color> On seeing Reunion improve by the day, has started to trust the Doctor and is willing to open the path forward.
<@lv.item><Originium Jetstream></>Continuously generates currents of airflow. Allied units moving downstream/upstream will have increased/decreased Movement Speed.
<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Units who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.
<@lv.rem>In this stage, Rhodes Island Operators gain a huge amount of SP when deployed.</>
act6fun_s02.npcDialogText: 'Like I told Talulah, I'm with you to the end. Don't get me wrong though, I just want to see how far you can take us.'
