point_A_pizzeria.pointDesc: The waiters show up only to bring out the menu and serve the food. They know that some conversations are best not overheard.

point_A_viale.pointDesc: The buildings along Cittanova's Main Street boast magnificent architecture, but their sharp edges and corners are a bit too sharp for some famiglie's tastes.

point_A_bar.pointDesc: Not everyone is a fan of this cafe's new varieties of coffee. Breaking old rules is a new anomaly.

point_A_parco.pointDesc: A good place to enjoy the breeze. However, the residents don't get too close to the tree-shaded areas, not since the body of a sanitation worker was found there.

point_A_hotel.pointDesc: Atop these tables, famiglie complete transactions and contests. Such is civilized socialization.

point_A_autolavaggio.pointDesc: A small carwash shop with a clerk of very few words. Business doesn't look too hot; only a few old acquaintances stop by.

point_B_prigione.pointDesc: The coming-of-age ceremony for a mafioso: once in the courthouse, once in the slammer.

point_B_fiori.pointDesc: Nobody cares to delve too deeply into why there's a florist next to the prison. The boss simply counts the money.

point_B_corte.pointDesc: Some civilians once watched a judge get pulled into a car and could only fearfully avert their eyes, not daring to peer behind the scenes.

point_B_ospedale.pointDesc: A hospital erected near the courthouse. In addition to the skills typically demanded of their profession, the doctors and nurses also know how to treat lesser-seen explosive and bolt wounds.

point_C_casa.pointDesc: Saluzzos never place their bets lightly.

point_C_cucina.pointDesc: The owner of the shop claims to be a nobody, but if an establishment never gets any 'solicitations' from a famiglia, everyone already knows what's going on.

point_C_vicoli.pointDesc: 'Never go into a back alley alone.' Every Siracusan child gets this half-advice, half-plea from their parents.

point_C_condominio.pointDesc: Poorer residents live here. A lot of things happen here, but the judges don't pay any extra attention to it.

point_D_teatro.pointDesc: Even if they have the money, ordinary citizens are reluctant to book a box seat.

point_D_pub.pointDesc: Once, a naive wise guy came here bragging about a deal he was about to score. The next day, people found a stiff corpse lying across the front of the doorway.

point_D_fuori.pointDesc: Workers are quickly taking down posters of an up-and-coming lead actor. In private, people whisper about his presence at a famiglia banquet the night before.

point_D_parcodeisentieri.pointDesc: A place citizens often go to pass the time. The shrubbery leading to a shortcut out of the park has already been trampled flat.

point_E_deposito.pointDesc: Exusiai saw a marking on the door, and without thinking twice, covered it up with graffiti commonly seen in the streets of Lungmen. Consequently, a few days later, an abandoned garage not too far away got blown up.

point_E_officina.pointDesc: If the wise guys show up, the repairman can do much more than just fix up electronics. He has the telltale callouses on his hands from the abrasion of a bowstring.

point_E_torre.pointDesc: Radio broadcasts are the best ways for Volsinii residents to keep abreast of the latest developments. The TV stations only want you to know what you're allowed to know.

point_F_chiesa.pointDesc: Devout worshippers by day, ruthless cutthroats who fight over their slice of the pie by night. On the surface, they appear plenty civilized.

point_F_torredi.pointDesc: Control the tower, and you control the city.
point_F_torredi.pointItaName: TORRE DI COMANDO DEL DISTRETTO CENTRALE SECONDARIO

point_G_municipio.pointDesc: 'The government is just the cloth draped over Grey Hall's round table.'

point_H_casarossati.pointDesc: The Rossatis, inheritors of Salvadore's legacy.

point_H_vialevecchio.pointDesc: The old streets of Volsinii are either packed with fighting famiglie, or completely empty.

point_I_casabellone.pointDesc: The Bellones, now mightiest in all the city.

point_I_vicoletti.pointDesc: Parents always tell their children not to kick tipped-over trash cans. You never know what bad things might roll out.

point_I_quartiere.pointDesc: The girl who lived here proudly proclaimed to her parents that she was seeing a young man from a famiglia. The smiles on their faces turned into an unfathomable expression.

char_card_Texas.charCardTitle: Wrathful, yet calm. Stagnant, yet ever coursing.
char_card_Texas.charCardDesc: The lone wolf who returned to the rainy city. Nothing has changed in seven years. Perhaps, finishing up the tasks she was given one-by-one will let her leave sooner.
char_card_Texas.fullCompleteDes: The lone wolf chose neither to stay nor to leave. She casts her gaze upon Siracusa, angrily urging it to change.

char_card_Lappland.charCardTitle: The wastes, seeking to break free from it all; an empty husk, filled to the brim.
char_card_Lappland.charCardDesc: The banished lone wolf who returned to the rainy city. In her eyes, Siracusa is a swamp, and she observes the fates of those who wish to escape it with bated breath.
char_card_Lappland.fullCompleteDes: The lone wolf breaks free from the swamp, also relinquishing control of herself, and steps into the wildness.

char_card_Lavinia.charCardTitle: Thorns that grow unyieldingly from beneath the umbral rain; full of scars, yet searching for a way forward.
char_card_Lavinia.charCardDesc: The word 'justice' should never cross the lips of a famiglia-backed judge, but she has never forgotten the ideals she set for herself when she first stepped into the courthouse, and still stands resolute.
char_card_Lavinia.fullCompleteDes: Instead of practicing the letter of the law, she now would prefer to lift the pen and draft new amendments.

char_card_Leontuzzo.charCardTitle: The conflicted young master of the wolfpack, emblematic of an era in flux.
char_card_Leontuzzo.charCardDesc: By all logic, the heir serves the bidding of the famiglia. Yet, he has never given up on questioning whether the path set by his father was the correct one, or contemplating the choices he should make.
char_card_Leontuzzo.fullCompleteDes: The wolfcub has grown. All he needs now is more time and experience.

char_card_Sora.charCardTitle: Return to me the moment that should be mine. That is all I ask, nothing more.
char_card_Sora.charCardDesc: When she found out that the theater she worked for was more than meets the eye, her resolve to protect her friends only grew stronger, regardless of what their identities might be.
char_card_Sora.fullCompleteDes: Her interpretation of 'La Morte di Texas' was not only of her friend's past, but also of her own present and future.
char_card_Sora.gainDesc: Unlocked through Cellinia Texas's Solo Action

char_card_Agenir.charCardTitle: Guns beget might, order begets law.
char_card_Agenir.charCardDesc: Asleep in the courthouse. Only found some people to talk to after waking up.
char_card_Agenir.fullCompleteDes: The old man heads back to the courthouse to resume his slumber. The old code of law may be changing, but this time, he does not hold the pen.

char_card_Giovanna.charCardTitle: Come back, o bygone days. You were once so beautiful.
char_card_Giovanna.charCardDesc: The Columbian famiglie needed to establish a foothold, and could have done all manner of things to accomplish that. If she hadn’t drawn her line in the sand.
char_card_Giovanna.fullCompleteDes: A new script is still being written. Look forward to the ending.

char_card_Danbrown.charCardTitle: A wanderer left behind by the times, a nobody who exposed the lies.
char_card_Danbrown.charCardDesc: He could only witness the 'liquidation' that exhilarated him in his dreams, and when he opened his eyes, the reality that presented itself convinced him that civilization had become cowardly and weak.
char_card_Danbrown.fullCompleteDes: He chose to return to the embrace of violence.
char_card_Danbrown.gainDesc: Unlocked through Lappland Saluzzo's Solo Action

char_card_Ben.charCardDesc: He is here to observe whether there are like-minded individuals who likewise refuse to acclimate to this wasteland masquerading as society.
char_card_Ben.fullCompleteDes: In his eyes, there is no difference between civilization and wasteland; however, new developments never fail to pique his interest.

char_card_Demetri.charCardTitle: A sharp dagger, a bottle of rich red wine, and a lingering sorrow.
char_card_Demetri.charCardDesc: Everything he did was to see the Bellones become the masters of Siracusa, and he staunchly believed that the Don would lead them there.
char_card_Demetri.fullCompleteDes: He turns around, walking away from his old friend. One day, they will find themselves standing against each other.
char_card_Demetri.gainDesc: Unlocked through Leontuzzo Bellone's Solo Action

taskRing_Texas_1.ringText: Maybe I'll find a restaurant I like before I get to work.

taskRing_Texas_2.ringText: Feeling a bit restless. Maybe I should head to the park to cool down.

taskRing_Texas_3.ringText: The prison guards seem to have something to say.

taskRing_Texas_4.ringText: The ones on the streets are mafiosi, not ordinary civilians.

taskRing_Texas_5.ringText: A singer's voice is coming through the radio... Is Sora in trouble?

taskRing_Texas_6.ringText: Maybe I'll figure something out if I go back to where I found the radio.

taskRing_Texas_7.ringText: Looks like Emperor wants to talk.

taskRing_Lappland_1.ringText: The moment I get back home, I'm already being given work.

taskRing_Lappland_2.ringText: Looks like the people here don’t take kindly to the way I do things.

taskRing_Lappland_3.ringText: Looks like Capone's finished everything I told him to do.

taskRing_Lappland_4.ringText: Time to head over to check on my little musbeast.

taskRing_Lappland_5.ringText: Capone seems to have something to say.

taskRing_Lavinia_1.ringText: Time to go home after a long day at work.

taskRing_Lavinia_2.ringText: This case is about to go to trial. I'll need to head to the archives and read up.

taskRing_Lavinia_3.ringText: Someone's waving at me on my way back from the Saluzzo Estate.

taskRing_Lavinia_4.ringText: Let's get this drunken former classmate back home first.

taskRing_Lavinia_5.ringText: Time to move. The young man seems to have something to say to me.

taskRing_Leontuzzo_1.ringText: Looks like my mission from the famiglia is to get that government official there in line.

taskRing_Leontuzzo_2.ringText: Things aren't going well. I'll head back to the estate for now.

taskRing_Leontuzzo_3.ringText: Demetri seems to have something to say.

taskRing_Leontuzzo_4.ringText: Just woke up... Most of the wise guys seem to have gone to the theater.

taskRing_Leontuzzo_5.ringText: Where's Lavinia? There's something I need to tell her.

taskRing_Leontuzzo_6.ringText: The funeral's over. I met a few residents who happened to pass by.

taskRing_Leontuzzo_7.ringText: I should ask Lavinia what she thinks.

taskRing_Sora_1.ringText: My dress is all ruined now... I need to get it fixed, quick.

taskRing_Sora_2.ringText: I need to go somewhere real quick to get the materials to fix the dress.

taskRing_Sora_3.ringText: Now that the dust has settled, I'd like invite everyone to watch the performance of Act III.

taskRing_Sora_4.ringText: The performance went perfectly. I want the others to know how happy I am.

taskRing_Giovanna_1.ringText: Time to deal with some famiglia business.

taskRing_Giovanna_2.ringText: Lots of unfinished work left on the schedule.

taskRing_Giovanna_3.ringText: I need to leave something behind for Cellinia.

taskRing_Giovanna_4.ringText: I hope Cellinia gets the chance to follow her heart.

taskRing_Giovanna_5.ringText: I think I'll go people-watching to get some inspiration for my next script.

taskRing_Danbrown_1.ringText: Done washing the car. Now to tell the client.

taskRing_Danbrown_2.ringText: There are a few wise guys drinking at the bar. They seem to be discussing something.

taskRing_Danbrown_3.ringText: Gonna talk to Ben again. Think I've figured some things out.

taskRing_Danbrown_4.ringText: Time to enjoy a show from the opera box.

taskRing_Danbrown_5.ringText: The Don wants me back. I'll decide after I take a look around the new city.

taskRing_Danbrown_6.ringText: Guess I'll head back to the famiglia then, and pay my respects to the Don.

taskRing_Agenir_1.ringText: I ran into Ben outside on my way from the church.

taskRing_Agenir_2.ringText: The courthouse is a great place to sleep. Hopefully nobody comes bothering me.

taskRing_Agenir_3.ringText: Judge Lavinia seems to have something to say.

taskRing_Ben_1.ringText: If a bystander were here, he would have to wonder–who is this man?

taskRing_Ben_2.ringText: Time to head over to the theater to watch the final act of 'La Morte di Texas.'

taskRing_Ben_3.ringText: So, what do I think about this whole thing?

taskRing_Demetri_1.ringText: I'll tell Leon the truth. He needs to talk things through with the Boss.

taskRing_Demetri_2.ringText: Looks like the next job is taking out Giovanna. Time to make preparations.

taskRing_Demetri_3.ringText: Need to calm down a bit. The hit's about to begin.

taskRing_Demetri_4.ringText: Looks like the newbie has something to say.

item_radio.itemDesc: A radio that suddenly appeared by the side of the road, currently broadcasting opera music. The person who received it was in such a hurry she did not realize she accidentally smashed one of its corners.

item_photo.itemDesc: An old photo. The little girl in it is dressed impeccably in formal attire, her somewhat naive eyes looking not at the camera, but at the person standing beside it. Were it not for the striking similarities, no one would believe that this is an old photo of Lappland.

item_bloodcode.itemDesc: Lavinia's Codex. A smudge of another judge's blood can be found on its cover, the finger that brushed against its thorns bearing the same will as hers. The Codex acknowledged his wound.

item_dagger.itemDesc: A short sword that bears testament to his status as a mafioso. A gift from father to son, representing the acknowledgement and expectations of the man who was both his father and don of the famiglia.

item_oldcode.itemDesc: An old legal codex. This was the earliest version of Siracusa's legal foundation, and upon it, the entire judicial system Siracusa would deploy.

item_ticket.itemItalyName: BIGLIETTO PER LA MORTE DI TEXAS
item_ticket.itemDesc: An admission ticket printed with extremely high fidelity. This opera telling the tale of a famous famiglia garnered respectable reviews. Combined with the recent developments in the city, the audience is eagerly awaiting the author's next opus.

item_pen.itemDesc: An exquisite fountain pen. Its user cherishes it very much, and the nib has been honed into a shape most suitable for her after thousands of compositions.

item_key.itemDesc: A delicate, intricate key. Only one such key exists for each box, a method used by the theater manager to ensure the safety of the mafiosi who come here to enjoy the shows.

item_trunk.itemDesc: A strong and durable luggage case. There does not seem to be anything inside it, as there is nothing he needs to take with him.

item_pastgift.itemDesc: A razor-sharp dagger. Its owner took this blade into possession, yet at the same time warned his fellow mafiosi not to take revenge on Leontuzzo Bellone in private.

item_poster.cardDesc: This is the first time a famiglia's name has formally appeared in the title of a work of art. The people who awaited it did not realize what this signified: that the winds of change had begun to blow.

item_redwine.cardDesc: Wine has many meanings, one of which is acknowledgment.

item_surprise.cardDesc: Sora prepared a gift for her long-lost friend, and still seems to be immersed in the joy of their fortuitous reunion.

item_flower.cardDesc: Beautiful, exquisite flowers, just enough to cover the stitches of the dress. The one who picked them was careful not to make even the slightest error.

item_chain.cardDesc: The shopkeeper seemed extremely capable. After hearing that Sora belonged to Compagnia dell'alba, those adroit hands became even more circumspect.

item_drink.cardDesc: The buyer knows her friends' tastes well, and purchased all of their favorite foods for them.

item_bribery.cardDesc: An unassuming package. Government officials know full well what they will find inside, as well as what they are expected to do.

item_officetoken.cardDesc: Officials will not leave behind any sort of evidence that can be used against them in a place like this. Their way of expressing obedience is sometimes as simple as a salutation or a bow.

item_thankflower.cardDesc: The judge was even willing to turn against her famiglia to help him, but the customers started questioning whether they should still associate with her while buying flowers.

item_borrow.cardDesc: The judges have long grown accustomed to the fact that a large number of files will be thrown into the archives with no closure, just like this one.

item_resume.cardDesc: From this neatly-written resume, one can already tell that its owner is serious and attentive. Its very existence is a form of hope.

item_inspiration.cardDesc: As long as events continue to unfold, the playwright will not put her pen down. She also eagerly anticipates what manner of work she will create next.

option_Texas_4_2_1_1.optionDesc: A rich girl who runs off with her brother

option_Texas_4_2_1_3.optionDesc: A rich girl who runs off with Salvadore

comment1.commentContent: The demise of Famiglia Texas was a result of Siracusa's old order, yet even the fall of such a prominent famiglia did not change anything. The status quo did not change, and the famiglie continued to fight amongst each other. The new Siracusa cannot continue down this path.

comment2.commentContent: Some of the details are realistic, uncannily so. The playwright must have some strong opinions about Texas to come up with an ending like that.

comment3.commentContent: Act III was staged successfully. Thankfully, it looks like the events of the preceding period did not interfere with the playwright's work after all. Very much looking forward to your next piece.

comment4.commentContent: My friend starred in the show, so I went to watch her. It was good. Also, goodbye.

comment5.commentContent: A satisfying ending, exactly how the story should've ended. It’s basically the image I have in my mind.

comment6.commentContent: I was eating popcorn in the theater and they kicked me out. Never got to finish.

comment7.commentContent: If things really did end that way, that might've been better for a lot of people

comment8.commentContent: This show was my Siracusan debut! A lot of unexpected things happened along the way, but the final performance turned out pretty good. It looks like the audience enjoyed it too, which makes me very happy!

comment9.commentContent: An unexpectedly good ending, avoiding falling into common clichés. The youth have the power to go beyond the status quo, and see things from a broader perspective. They are the saplings of our future.

comment10.commentContent: It's clear that the playwright shifted her paradigm once, and this shift elevated the quality of the entire opera to another level, bringing it from a personal story with a heroic narrative style to an evocative Siracusan tale. That’s enough for now. I’ll save rest of my commentary for the arts papers.

comment11.commentContent: Was recommended by a friend, and don't regret it at all. After watching too many shows playing up the greatness of the famiglie, a whole lot of people come to see themselves in the great, heroic mafiosi depicted in those operas. And that's a dangerous thing.

comment12.commentContent: This is my first time using this new rating system. It was also my first time watching an opera in a theater, which was kind of strange. By the end, I was shouting along with the others. I might have to ask the author myself – what did he choose at the end? To pick up the phone, or to throw away those old rapiers?

comment13.commentContent: I just happened to stop by after work to kill some time, and I didn't expect the show to be so good. I was blown away when I saw that judge get knocked out and stuffed into the trunk. The author writes unexpected while still realistic twists, carrying a message through. Will recommend to friends.

comment14.commentContent: A pretty good show, great for enjoying with friends. It's fun listening to them try to break down the plot. The introductions at the beginning were hard to keep track of; I was fine personally, but someone was about to doze off.

comment15.commentContent: Pretty interesting. Not much else to say.

comment16.commentContent: Unfortunately, I missed the beginning. It's something that happens more and more as you get older. Fortunately, the latter half was exciting. The last few stories all unfolded in the same little room, which was an interesting spin.

comment17.commentContent: Story was very interesting, but those two crooks reminded me of some former subordinates of mine who could never follow instructions. The boss's line stuck with me: 'Just don't hire idiots.'

comment18.commentContent: A rarely-seen style. In somewhat ironic fashion, explores the true story of a multi-party struggle, reflecting the dark side of the famiglie's activities. Begins by introducing the backgrounds of a cast of characters, leading to the titular theme, then finally leaving the audience on a suspenseful note. Flows naturally, good show.

comment19.commentContent: Bring your friends! I was almost kicked out for bringing pizza to the door, but we ate it on the spot. The story's really amazing, and I want to get to know the playwright. Acting in a show like this is sure to expand my acting career!

comment20.commentContent: The playwright's creativity is worth learning from. While everyone else uses serious narratives to tell the stories of the famiglie, this author took the completely opposite approach. Moreover, a number of coincidences occur in this show, but they are presented in a way that always feels natural and not jarring. Very impressive.

comment21.commentContent: Did the playwright know about the gangsters that got ran out of Siracusa? Their ringleader was a red-haired Vulpo, and the protagonist bore too many similarities to him. Impulsive and arrogant, yet not dislikable at all. The other two brothers, one calm, one brash, matched them perfectly as well!

comment22.commentContent: It’s the lowest wise guy who hates his famiglia, all while clinging to it, yearning for it, until he finally betrays the brothers who were there for him all the way up the ladder just to save his own skin. It’s what it is.

comment23.commentContent: Had to leave halfway through because something came up. But, it was still pretty touching to see three like-minded young men. You don’t see such tight-knit fratelli these days.

comment24.commentContent: Like-minded youths always seem to come together. Really takes me back.

comment26.commentContent: The playwright still needs some refinement. Beginning a story with minor characters is a common maneuver. It reflects the changing times, as well as personal development and choices. Unfortunately, the execution didn't pan out in the end.

comment27.commentContent: Just the same run-of-the-mill stuff I see every day after work. You know what the playwright is trying to convey through these three characters, but unfortunately, they don’t have the skills to pull it off.

comment28.commentContent: Next time, I'm going to ask the boss if we can shoot a film about a group of friends, just like this. We’ll move the setting from Lungmen to Siracusa. Dunno about anyone else, but I sure wanna star in that myself★!

comment29.commentContent: What the playwright seeks to express is evident, but unfortunately, cannot fully do so due to a lack of ability. For example, the brothers' rebellion at the end should've reflected the famiglia's principle of self-interest above all else, yet this was written off as a farce. But having that said, were it not for that bit of expressiveness, the entire opera would've been a complete waste of time.

comment30.commentContent: I didn't really understand what the show was getting at. I wanted to ask someone to explain it to me, but the judge lady who told me to check it out hasn’t come by. I'm not sure how she feels about it in the first place. Maybe I'm not cut out for the opera.

comment31.commentContent: I heard that the directing team recently won an award. I hope the show actually earned it, and isn’t just another mediocre product propped up to fluff Signora Sicilia. It's not fair to hardworking playwrights.

comment32.commentContent: Never expected this play to be so long. I fell asleep halfway through, and got woken up by the people next to me. Almost got kicked out of the theater again. Seeing them trying to fluff up the famiglie like that at the end, not to mention Signora Sicilia, was pretty damned funny.

comment33.commentContent: The title of the play caught my fancy, and I originally planned to study up on the actors, but the story itself was rather disappointing. It should've been about the history and evolution of Siracusa over the years, as well as the conflicts among the famiglie both above-board and behind-the-scenes, but they kept forcing in those strange little praises instead of treating the subject matter seriously. Also, the actors looked pretty lost.

comment34.commentContent: Hahaha, you sure worked your ass off, director!

comment35.commentContent: Like so many other commenters, I was drawn in by the title. I thought it would be a historical documentary based on primary sources. I was pretty disappointed. If you're looking to study this to improve your writing, I'd stay home instead.

comment36.commentContent: After thinking on it, I finally decided to buy another ticket. When would be a good time to invite her to come see it? What a fascinating performance.

comment37.commentContent:
About halfway through, I decided it'd be more worthwhile to throw a party! Croissant was right, I should've sold apple pie at the door! 
*Edited 3 days later* Huh? Turns out, I went to the wrong number, haha!

comment38.commentContent: Shows like this are a quick way to score fame and fortune, and the fact that it's won awards is unsurprising. However, I've been thinking recently–if people get too used to this logic, they’ll just keep talking up whoever’s actually allowed to speak, even if Grey Hall and the famiglie cease to exist.

comment39.commentContent: Playwright? Bah, whoever created this doesn't deserve the title. All he knows how to do is grab some pretentious words, some inflammatory ones, and some trendy topics to bait people into paying for it. Slap this hodgepodge together, and call it a finished work!

comment40.commentTitle: Never should've been put on stage
comment40.commentContent: Some of my subordinates recommended me this opera. They genuinely believe in the history it recounts, as well as the lofty heights to which it lifts the famiglie. Siracusa's famiglie were never meant to be her saviors. Harboring such illusions in the first place would only serve to destroy the famiglia.

comment42.commentContent: You rarely see shows this bad. A complete waste of the time I have after work. I probably should've realized what I was getting into when I saw the long list of companies in the credits.

comment43.commentContent: A lot of people started walking out, so I went up to the front. There were lots of exciting fight scenes, so that was good.

comment44.commentContent: I'd rather try nibbling on thistles.

comment45.commentContent: Quite inferior, even if we're purely speaking from the perspective of a playwright's creative process. There were actually seven main characters, all of which died in the end. Combined with the tragic music, I was left utterly speechless.

comment46.commentContent: This eye mask is good at blocking out the light, and the performance did a great job of putting me to sleep.

comment47.commentContent: There are hardly any shows these days that can make me laugh out loud, and they only get fewer and farther between. So just for that alone, nine points!

comment48.commentContent: I decided to watch it because of the reviews, so I understand where the polarized ratings come from. I remember watching a movie from Lungmen before that had some nice fights between the gangsters and the cops. What the hell was this?

comment49.commentContent: If a Lungmen movie ever turned out this bad, a certain someone would make a fifty-long diss track.

comment50.commentContent: Had to walk out halfway through. On the way back, I finally figured out what was so weird. Siracusa doesn't even have police! The Lungmen-style gangster flick adapted it to a judge and the wise guys doing drive-by crossbow shootings, which was beyond hilarious. Too bad the boss isn't here, because I'd LOVE for him to get a load of this.

missions.riddle: Science has always been beyond reason. When power armors block the way in the hallways of the test site, the first step to starting research is to carefully observe and deal with test subjects along with anything that may cause a reaction.

group_1.name: Logistics Squad
group_1.desc: The Logistics Squad under your command is proficient in logistics and transportation. Their goal is to transport strategic supplies to Londinium.

group_2.name: Intel Squad
group_2.desc: The Intel Squad under your command is proficient in reconnaissance and intel analysis. Their goal is to gather intel in Londinium.

group_3.name: Medical Squad
group_3.desc: The Medical Squad under your command is proficient in emergency response and rescue. Their goal is to offer medical aid in Londinium.

stage_1.name: Battlefield of Originium and Gunfire
stage_1.desc:
Objective: Londinium.
Prolonged sieges have transformed the city into a nightmare. The squad is about to enter the warzone and has already detected significantly elevated levels of airborne active Originium. Brace yourselves; this journey will be treacherous.
stage_1.stageFailureDescription: The squad is inadequately prepared. Please retreat from the battlefield immediately. (Insufficient stats)

stage_2.name: Sudden Catastrophe
stage_2.desc: We received a warning from Closure about an incoming Catastrophe in our area. Please advise.
stage_2.stageFailureDescription: The squad is ill-prepared, and the mission has failed. Evacuate immediately for your safety. (Insufficient stats)

stage_3.name: Stray Troops
stage_3.desc: Our scouts report approximately a hundred soldiers stationed ahead. Their uniforms and gear indicate they are mostly Sarkaz mercenaries and Victorian conscripts. They share the same camp, but many are wounded and on high alert. Attempting contact may be risky. Please advise.
stage_3.stageFailureDescription: The squad is ill-prepared, and the mission has failed. Evacuate immediately for your safety. (Insufficient stats)

stage_4.name: Londinium Imminent
stage_4.desc: We've crossed the frontline, and the final challenge lies right ahead. The city's surroundings are extremely dangerous, so please help us find a way to reach our objective.
stage_4.stageFailureDescription: The squad is ill-prepared, and the mission has failed. Evacuate immediately for your safety. (Insufficient stats)

target_1_1.name: 1A - Ready Up
target_1_1.desc: Your goal is to help those in need and minimize tragedies. Act with caution—it's hard to tell what lies in store for us.
target_1_1.successDesc: We have entered the warzone and can clearly see Originium clusters in the strange weather. We will provide live updates on any further encounters. Please be ready to advise.

target_2_1.name: 2A - Post Haste
target_2_1.desc: There's no time to formulate a detailed plan. You must try to cross the Catastrophe forecast region right away.
target_2_1.successDesc: Your prediction was spot-on: giant Originium clusters emerged in the Catastrophe forecast region as soon as the storm hit. Fortunately, we acted swiftly and avoided the area in advance.

target_2_2.name: 2B - Improvise
target_2_2.desc: With your squad’s ample experience and resources, the incoming Catastrophe will pose little threat.
target_2_2.successDesc: Your prediction was spot-on: the Catastrophe was manageable. We exited the region after using some supplies.

target_3_1.name: 3A - Roundabout
target_3_1.desc: You have enough supplies to find a way around these soldiers and another path forward.
target_3_1.successDesc: Under the strange sky, those soldiers looked as weary as we did. Per your directions, we took a detour and avoided their camp. Although it cost more time and resources, fortunately, there were no casualties.

target_3_2.name: 3B - In Stealth
target_3_2.desc: Based on your intel, I have analyzed their activity zones and patrol routes. There should be a path here that allows safe and rapid passage.
target_3_2.successDesc: Following your instructions, we crossed their camp unseen during their shift change. Their supplies were low, and their gear was damaged.

target_3_3.name: 3C - Provide Aid
target_3_3.desc: You can offer them medical aid in exchange for passage. Rhodes Island Operators tend to the sick and wounded anywhere and should not turn a blind eye here.
target_3_3.successDesc: Per your instructions, we declared our intention, and the two desperate troops invited us into their camp. Most of the soldiers were severely injured, the best we could do was provide basic medical aid and leave them some medicine before departing.

target_4_1.name: End A - Appropriate Adaptation
target_4_1.desc: You can improvise and build makeshift wall-scaling gear from the available supplies.
target_4_1.successDesc:
We climbed the city outskirts and reached the edge of the plate next to the city. Our makeshift equipment allowed us to bring most of our supplies. The area was eerily quiet despite the many wrecked buildings. As we searched, it became clear that residents had left in a hurry. In one apartment, we found broken and stained dolls on the dinner table, evidence of their hasty departure. Something feels off about this place, but we're determined to complete the mission.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned. Wish us luck.

target_4_2.name: End B - Well Prepared
target_4_2.desc: You have collected ample intel on Londinium and its surroundings. I can now formulate the final step of this operation.
target_4_2.successDesc:
We have arrived at the city's auxiliary plates following your route. The mobility layer here is neglected, with broken equipment scattered everywhere. Fortunately, the support structures remain stable, so there's no risk of collapse. In the support layer, we found many residents who fled their homes. A stable society has formed here due to the long-term unrest above. Many fear the Sarkaz and are unwilling to return to the residential layer, describing the city as chaotic. Nevertheless, it remains our objective. We provided necessities to this 'city within a city' before moving on. We are currently heading to the city office as planned.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned. Please keep comms clear.

target_4_3.name: End C - Deep in Danger
target_4_3.desc: You can try traversing the no man's land filled with active Originium to reach the city perimeter.
target_4_3.successDesc:
In the area with the highest active Originium concentrations, we encountered Sarkaz mercenaries who had retreated from the Redmane Mountains and were left to die in the wastes. They refused our medical aid. When a sudden catastrophe struck, we gave them our equipment. Afterward, some mercenaries decided to join us on our journey to the city in exchange for more supplies, despite being labeled 'traitors' by their peers.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned, and our team is stronger than when we first set out.

target_4_4.name: End D - Resolute Breakout
target_4_4.desc: Your team is adequately prepared and can try to charge straight to the final objective point.
target_4_4.successDesc:
On our way to the Londinium outskirts, we encountered three groups of people. The first group comprised refugees who had fled the city long ago but were stranded on the outskirts due to difficult terrain. They seemed mentally well and adequately supplied, playing cards and chatting as we passed. Closer to the city, we met armed Victorian soldiers, their physical and mental strain evident. Lastly, we came across a distraught group of Londinium residents who had just fled the city. They were in a dire state, trembling as they described how the city was littered with Londinier and Sarkaz corpses and how the remaining survivors were on the brink of collapse. We fear the worst for Londinium.
We are currently heading towards the city office as planned. Hopefully, things are slightly better there.

target_4_5.name: End E - All Under Control
target_4_5.desc: This operation is already in the bag. I have countless contingency plans to guarantee its success.
target_4_5.successDesc:
We ultimately decided to follow the Confessarius's tracks and entered the city via a hidden passage, bringing all our supplies into Londinium. The war ravaged city faces multiple crises: its resources depleted, its people weary, and its future uncertain. We distributed our supplies to those in dire need, though many still remain unhelped. We've also received news that other Rhodes Island teams are arriving in Londinium. Hopefully, our efforts will make a difference.
We are currently executing our mission as planned; thank you for your unwavering support and guidance.

event_0_1.name: Unsafe Ground
event_0_1.desc: We encountered a strange area where towering Originium clusters obstruct our path. What was once a safe route is now dangerous. Some of the Originium might even be active. Please advise.

event_0_2.name: Equipment Failure
event_0_2.desc: We encountered trouble: Originium dust has caused our precision instruments to malfunction. This is particularly concerning in an area prone to minor Catastrophes. Please advise.

event_0_3.name: Wasteland Bandits
event_0_3.desc: We encountered hostile forces in the wastes and are currently at an impasse. They appear to be thugs surviving by robbing refugees. They refuse to negotiate and are threatening us to surrender our supplies. Please advise.

event_0_4.name: Urgent News
event_0_4.desc:
Message from Closure:
'Doctor, the team is currently in an area with no signal coverage, but our readings indicate an imminent Catastrophe. Please advise.'

event_1_1.name: Escapees
event_1_1.desc: We ran into some refugees who claim to be settlers of the surrounding wastes. Their settlements were destroyed by Catastrophe, and they are hoping we can provide them supplies to survive on, as they fled with nothing. Please advise.

event_1_2.name: Minor Catastrophes
event_1_2.desc: We have discovered a possible pattern in the onset of minor Catastrophes in certain areas, but this is just speculation with no hard evidence. Some team members have suggested we analyze it based on existing intelligence. Please advise.

event_1_3.name: Abandoned Village
event_1_3.desc: Our scouts have discovered a recently abandoned village where we might find usable supplies. Should we go ahead and search the place?

event_2_1.name: Battleship Wreck
event_2_1.desc: We found the wreckage of a high-speed battleship, likely from previous Victorian reconnaissance forces. It appears unoccupied from a distance. Should we proceed with a search?

event_2_2.name: Stragglers
event_2_2.desc: Our scouts discovered a dozen or so soldiers in Victorian military attire stationed in a simple camp, presumably deserters. Should we make contact with them?

event_2_3.name: Radiant Flash
event_2_3.desc: We observed a sudden golden radiance in the sky, dispersing the lingering crimson clouds. This unexpected event may impact our mission plans. Please advise.

event_3_1.name: Retreating Sarkaz Forces
event_3_1.desc: Our scouts have spotted a large Sarkaz contingent on the march, likely an elite unit retreating from the Silverrock Bluffs frontline to Londinium. It might take them some time to fully pass. Please advise.

event_3_2.name: Establishing Comms
event_3_2.desc: We are located near Londinium and establishing a dedicated but simple comms base here would benefit the mission. However, conditions are worse than expected, and accidents may occur. Please advise.

event_3_3.name: Helpless Child
event_3_3.desc: We found a child dressed in rags in the wastes, crying out and asking us to help his wounded parents. They are not far from our location, but they may slow us down. Please advise.

event_4_1.name: Londinium Refugees
event_4_1.desc: We ran into a group of civilians claiming to be refugees from Londinium who dare not return home, but cannot leave the wastes, either. Please advise.

event_4_2.name: Patrol Squad
event_4_2.desc: A Sarkaz patrol squad in the distance has spotted us. Estimated contact in five minutes. Please advise.

event_4_3.name: Evade Sentry
event_4_3.desc: We are less than a day away from the city, but have also spotted Sarkaz sentry outposts nearby. How should we approach them?

eventSerial_1_1.name: Support Platform (1/3)
eventSerial_1_1.desc: Following a message from Closure, we proceeded to a nearby location for a support mission. We discovered a wrecked transport drone and its cargo, a smart combat platform with the ID: PhonoR-0. The platform is currently offline. Please advise. (Completing the final mission can greatly increase your Logistics Ability)

eventSerial_1_2.name: Support Platform (2/3)
eventSerial_1_2.desc:
Doctor, we have connected with the drone dispatched to support PhonoR-0 and are currently modifying it as Closure directed.
However, there is a disagreement: PhonoR-0 wants to be modified and carry out the mission alone, while Closure believes we should continue modifying the drone and work together. Please advise.

eventSerial_1_3.name: Support Platform (3/3)
eventSerial_1_3.desc: We received PhonoR-0's emergency signal. Shrouded in mist and chased by multiple robed enemies, she must have been attacked by Nachzehrers. We're en route to assist. Please advise.

eventSerial_2_1.name: Knight-errant (1/4)
eventSerial_2_1.desc: We received an encrypted signal from a Rhodes Island standard beacon. It contains important content that requires physical recovery of the beacon to view. However, we detected Sarkaz troops while en route to the beacon. Please advise on how we should proceed. (Completing the final mission can greatly increase your Intel Ability)

eventSerial_2_2.name: Knight-errant (2/4)
eventSerial_2_2.desc: Based on clues from the message, we discovered a secret hideout in some ruins, along with the beacon and its deceased courier, who happened to be an Infected. There were other refugees present who, despite being extremely cautious, did not attack us. We have retrieved the beacon and will investigate the courier's cause of death. Please advise on how to handle the refugees.

eventSerial_2_3.name: Knight-errant (3/4)
eventSerial_2_3.desc: We deciphered the beacon's encrypted message and found a clue from Operator Ch'en. The deceased Infected had been hunted down for killing Sarkaz and was saved by Ch'en, who suggested he seek help from Rhodes Island. She also left a set of coordinates in the message. As we approached, we could see a deserted camp in the distance. Please advise.

eventSerial_2_4.name: Knight-errant (4/4)
eventSerial_2_4.desc: Sure enough, we found another clue left by Operator Ch'en. Again, we retrieved the beacon and attempted to decipher its message.

eventSerial_3_1.name: Sly Shadows (1/5)
eventSerial_3_1.desc: We met a non-hostile group of Sarkaz mercenaries who recognized us and even invited us to raid the nearby Sarkaz altar guarded by Confessarii. Their team emblem is an unusual smiley face, and they carry numerous explosives. Please advise. (Completing the final mission can greatly increase your Medical Ability)

eventSerial_3_2.name: Sly Shadows (2/5)
eventSerial_3_2.desc: We found traces of the Confessarius bodyguards again. There are only Originium clusters and Confessarius corpses in this area. We're guessing a fierce battle took place here recently. Please advise.

eventSerial_3_3.name: Sly Shadows (3/5)
eventSerial_3_3.desc:
We came across a Self-Salvation Corps camp while catching up to the Followers. They were attacked on their way to the city and suffered heavy losses. They sent a distress signal and a doctor responded, but have lost contact. 
A small group of Sarkaz troops are currently headed their way, so how should we aid them?

eventSerial_3_4.name: Sly Shadows (4/5)
eventSerial_3_4.desc: We followed clues related to the Followers and received a distress signal from a Rhodes Island beacon. We followed it to a Confessarius laboratory. Sarkaz often patrol the area, so we don't have much time to explore. What kind of information should we focus on?

eventSerial_3_5.name: Sly Shadows (5/5)
eventSerial_3_5.desc: Our team is almost at Londinium. We were figuring out a way to enter the heavily fortified city when the special communication equipment from Operator Shining received a strange signal. Please advise.

eventSerialChoice_1_1_1.name: Try to repair
eventSerialChoice_1_1_1.desc: PhonoR-0 is on an urgent mission; you must begin repairs at once.
eventSerialChoice_1_1_1.successDesc: We repaired PhonoR-0. Our squad will travel with her until the next transport drone arrives.
eventSerialChoice_1_1_1.failureDesc: We failed to repair it. Please dispatch any nearby teams to support as we press on.

eventSerialChoice_1_2_1.name: Go with Closure's plan
eventSerialChoice_1_2_1.desc: Trust Closure's judgement as an engineer.
eventSerialChoice_1_2_1.successDesc:
Received news from Closure: 
'You know I'm right, Doctor! I can't believe she's insisting on acting alone even in such a dangerous place. I usually don't disagree with the combat platforms, though. Is that the power of kinship?'
eventSerialChoice_1_2_1.failureDesc: We failed to modify it. The transport drone will carry PhonoR-0 to meet up with a nearby squad as we press on.

eventSerialChoice_1_2_2.name: Go with PhonoR-0's plan
eventSerialChoice_1_2_2.successDesc:
Received news from PhonoR-0: 
'I appreciate your trust in me, Doctor. The previous accident has proven the drone unreliable, and as such acting alone seemed preferable. Do forgive my haste, as Aefanyl is in danger and I must locate him myself.'
eventSerialChoice_1_2_2.failureDesc: We failed to modify it. Please dispatch any nearby teams to support as we press on.

eventSerialChoice_1_3_1.name: Steady Tactics
eventSerialChoice_1_3_1.desc: Slow your steps and use the safest method to wipe them out.
eventSerialChoice_1_3_1.successDesc:
We lured the enemy into a trap, scattering and routing them.
The communication band has received a message from PhonoR-0: 
'Thank you for the support.'
eventSerialChoice_1_3_1.failureDesc:
We defeated the enemy with some difficulty, but PhonoR-0 was damaged in the process. She can fix herself with spells to some extent, but it won't be enough to continue her mission.
Our team lacks the resources to fully repair her, so please dispatch a nearby team to help us out.

eventSerialChoice_1_3_2.name: Radical Tactics
eventSerialChoice_1_3_2.desc: Attack them directly and wipe them out.
eventSerialChoice_1_3_2.successDesc:
We won the direct confrontation with no casualties.
The communication band has received a message from PhonoR-0: 
'Thank you for the support. I am truly relieved Aefanyl has friends like you.'
eventSerialChoice_1_3_2.failureDesc:
We defeated the enemy with some difficulty, but PhonoR-0 was damaged in the process. She can fix herself with spells to some extent, but it won't be enough to continue her mission.

eventSerialChoice_1_3_3.name: Surprise Tactics
eventSerialChoice_1_3_3.desc: Observe the terrain and quickly formulate a plan to take them by surprise.
eventSerialChoice_1_3_3.successDesc:

'Thank you for the support. I am truly relieved Aefanyl has friends like you.'
eventSerialChoice_1_3_3.failureDesc:
We defeated the enemy with some difficulty, but PhonoR-2 was damaged in the process. She can fix herself with spells to some extent, but it won't be enough to continue her mission.
Our team lacks the resources to fully repair her, so please dispatch a nearby team to help us out.

eventSerialChoice_2_1_1.name: Lure Tactics
eventSerialChoice_2_1_1.desc: Prepare to engage and entice the enemy to attack first.
eventSerialChoice_2_1_1.successDesc: We lured the Sarkaz troops into an ambush and eliminated them with some difficulty, but whoever was carrying the Rhodes Island signal beacon seems to have fled during the fight. We will now head towards Londinium as we track down the beacon.
eventSerialChoice_2_1_1.failureDesc: An accident occurred during our fight with the Sarkaz troops. Even though we managed to wipe them out in the chaos, the one carrying the Rhodes Island signal beacon was confirmed dead and the beacon itself damaged when we cleaned up the place. Our team will recover it and press on.

eventSerialChoice_2_1_2.successDesc: We heeded your command and eliminated them in a direct fight, but whoever was carrying the Rhodes Island signal beacon seems to have fled during the fight. We will now head towards Londinium as we track down the beacon.

eventSerialChoice_2_1_3.successDesc: The support squad arrived in time and our cooperation went smoothly, but whoever was carrying the Rhodes Island signal beacon seems to have fled during the fight. We have discovered he's an Infected on his way to Londinium. We will now head towards Londinium as we track down the beacon.

eventSerialChoice_2_2_1.name: Contact with caution
eventSerialChoice_2_2_1.desc: Exercise caution as you approach the people in the hideout.
eventSerialChoice_2_2_1.successDesc: We carefully confronted the group of Infected. They were ultimately convinced that we held no ill will and left the hideout. Our team will recover the beacon and press on, deciphering the content as we go.
eventSerialChoice_2_2_1.failureDesc:
Even though we held ourselves back as we confronted the refugees, they remained wary.
We examined the deceased under their watchful eyes, and according to our rough analysis, he was killed by some sort of Sarkaz witchcraft. Unfortunately his beacon was also destroyed, so we cannot retrieve the information. Our squad will press on.

eventSerialChoice_2_2_2.name: Show your skills
eventSerialChoice_2_2_2.desc: Show your skills and help the people in the hideout, gaining their trust.
eventSerialChoice_2_2_2.successDesc:
We showed off our skills as we helped out the hideout residents, and they left once they were convinced we held no ill will.
According to a rough analysis, the deceased was killed by some sort of Sarkaz witchcraft and cannot be identified. Our team will recover the beacon and press on, deciphering the content as we go.
eventSerialChoice_2_2_2.failureDesc:
We showed the refugees our professional skills as we helped them out, but that only increased their vigilance.
We examined the deceased under their watchful eyes, and according to our rough analysis, he was killed by some sort of Sarkaz witchcraft. Unfortunately his beacon was also destroyed, so we cannot retrieve the information. Our squad will press on.

eventSerialChoice_2_2_3.name: Identify yourselves
eventSerialChoice_2_2_3.desc: Tell everyone in the hideout you come from Rhodes Island.
eventSerialChoice_2_2_3.successDesc:
The residents seem to know of Rhodes Island, and left after helping us out.
They said the Infected we were after was already dead when they came here.
According to a rough analysis, the deceased was killed by some sort of Sarkaz witchcraft and cannot be identified. Our team will recover the beacon and press on, deciphering the content as we go.
eventSerialChoice_2_2_3.failureDesc:
The refugees seem to have never heard of Rhodes Island, and our communication was bumpy.
We examined the deceased under their watchful eyes, and according to our rough analysis, he was killed by some sort of Sarkaz witchcraft. Unfortunately his beacon was also destroyed, so we cannot retrieve the information. Our squad will press on.

eventSerialChoice_2_3_1.desc: Conduct a brief search and then press on.
eventSerialChoice_2_3_1.successDesc:
We briefly searched the camp and found traces of recent human activity along with abandoned supplies, but nothing else.
Our team will press on and catch up with Operator Ch'en as we head towards Londinium.
eventSerialChoice_2_3_1.failureDesc: We searched the camp, but unfortunately did not find any useful clues. We gave up and will press on as planned.

eventSerialChoice_2_3_2.name: Standard search
eventSerialChoice_2_3_2.desc: Spend some time and effort looking through the camp.
eventSerialChoice_2_3_2.successDesc:

Our team will press on and catch up with Operator Ch'en as we head towards Londinium.
eventSerialChoice_2_3_2.failureDesc: We searched the camp, but unfortunately did not find any useful clues. We gave up and will press on as planned.

eventSerialChoice_2_3_3.name: Thorough search
eventSerialChoice_2_3_3.desc: Search the place thoroughly for any clues.
eventSerialChoice_2_3_3.successDesc:
We searched the camp thoroughly and found traces of recent human activity along with abandoned supplies.
There were also some shrouded Infected remains—members of the group we ran into earlier when we recovered the beacon.
We guess this was the group Operator Ch'en was after. Our team will press on and catch up with Operator Ch'en as we head towards Londinium.
eventSerialChoice_2_3_3.failureDesc: We searched the camp, but unfortunately did not find any useful clues. We gave up and will press on as planned.

eventSerialChoice_2_4_1.name: Decipher message
eventSerialChoice_2_4_1.successDesc:
Colleagues from Rhodes Island: 
I have confirmed that Nine has not led Reunion out of Londinium, and our key person of interest Talulah has also been sighted around the city. It is highly likely that Reunion has infiltrated the city, so I trust my colleagues will be extra careful. Also, I'll go look for them myself. — Ch'en'
eventSerialChoice_2_4_1.failureDesc: We failed to decipher it. We do not understand the message.

eventSerialChoice_3_1_1.name: Provide resources
eventSerialChoice_3_1_1.desc: Give them the necessary supplies and avoid direct conflict.
eventSerialChoice_3_1_1.successDesc:
We chose not to charge in blindly, but the supplies we offered helped them blow up the altar without a hitch. Only a small number of Confessarius guards escaped.
Our team will track them down as we continue our mission.
eventSerialChoice_3_1_1.failureDesc:
The operation was arduous, but we managed to blow up the altar. The Confessarius guards were wiped out. The mercenaries suffered heavy losses, and we helped them replenish any needed supplies.
We investigated the place, but did not find out what the guards were doing here. The team will press on.

eventSerialChoice_3_1_2.name: Provide remote support
eventSerialChoice_3_1_2.desc: Use crossbows and Arts to support them from a distance.
eventSerialChoice_3_1_2.successDesc:
Our support from afar helped them complete their objective smoothly. The altar was successfully blown up. The mercenaries thanked us and left chasing after the remaining guards.
Our team will track them down as we continue our mission.
eventSerialChoice_3_1_2.failureDesc:

eventSerialChoice_3_1_3.name: Unite and fight
eventSerialChoice_3_1_3.desc: Prepare for close combat and raid the altar together.
eventSerialChoice_3_1_3.successDesc:
Our cooperation went smoothly and the altar was blown up. The mercenaries told us the Confessarius leader was gathering forces and the guards were constantly mentioning a strange name—'Qui'saršinnag'.
A small number of Confessarius guards escaped. Our team will track them down as we continue our mission.
eventSerialChoice_3_1_3.failureDesc:

eventSerialChoice_3_2_1.name: Explore the battlefield
eventSerialChoice_3_2_1.desc: Check the battlefield for clues and speculate on who the Confessarius guards fought.
eventSerialChoice_3_2_1.successDesc:
We briefly searched the place, and discovered the Confessarius guards from earlier. With some difficulty we managed to wipe them out.
We only found some scraps of intelligence. Our team has analyzed the location it mentioned and will act accordingly.
eventSerialChoice_3_2_1.failureDesc:
We found traces of the Confessarius guards during our search, and defeated them with some difficulty.
Unfortunately, we failed to collect any useful intelligence. The team will continue moving towards Londinium.

eventSerialChoice_3_2_2.successDesc:

Based on our collected intel,
it is likely that they fought another Rhodes Island squad earlier.
Our team has analyzed the location the unidentified target might be heading to and will act accordingly.
eventSerialChoice_3_2_2.failureDesc:

it is likely that they fought the Followers earlier, currently somewhere unreachable.
Our team has analyzed the location where they might be heading to and will act accordingly.
eventSerialChoice_3_2_3.failureDesc:

eventSerialChoice_3_4_1.desc: Keep an eye on Followers-related intelligence.
eventSerialChoice_3_4_1.successDesc: We collected a special comms terminal and received a message left by Operator Shining: 'To Rhodes Island: we're out of danger for now and are on our way to support the other squads, but Liz needs urgent and specialized treatment, so we will head to the Confessarius Laboratory before moving on to Londinium. Please take care of the terminal.'
eventSerialChoice_3_4_1.failureDesc: An accident occurred in the laboratory. The abandoned building collapsed, and some team members were injured. We failed to collect any useful intelligence.

eventSerialChoice_3_4_2.successDesc: There were traces of battle and some Chimera corpses in the laboratory. eventSerialChoice_3_4_2.failureDesc: An accident occurred in the laboratory. The abandoned building collapsed, and some team members were injured. We failed to collect any useful intelligence.

eventSerialChoice_3_5_1.successDesc:
We discovered a passage, possibly the secret channel used by the Confessarii to move to and from the city.
We also found material related to the Confessarius experiments. These files may help Rhodes Island better understand their movements.
eventSerialChoice_3_5_1.failureDesc:
We failed to understand the significance of the special communicator's signal.
Our team will abandon this lead and look for another way to enter Londinium.

broadcast_1.content: Arriving at conflict zone. Please ensure the team has enough supplies.

broadcast_2.content: Each team has their own unique strengths, so let them fully make of them.

broadcast_3.content: Some event decisions may affect future situations.

broadcast_4.content: The Sarkaz are congregating away from Londinium, and this squad boasts elites from both the Vampire and Nachzehrer Royal Courts.

broadcast_5.content: A Catastrophe is currently on the move to the west of Westbound Forest.

broadcast_6.content: The Victorian Army is withdrawing from the western frontline and moving towards the Silverrock Bluffs on the Duskglow River—Redmane Mountains line.

broadcast_7.content: Squads led by Operators Closure, Fang, and Misery have reached the battlefield and are preparing to establish a comms network. All teams, please provide support alongside your duties.

broadcast_8.content: Take note: each has their own strengths, and no squad can perfectly handle every problem they encounter.

broadcast_10.content: Confessarius guards are fighting alongside strange enemies called 'Chimeras.' Avoid direct engagement.

broadcast_11.content: Both the Victorian and Sarkaz armies have gathered at Silverrock Bluffs and may start a conflict any time.

broadcast_12.content: The Nachzehrer can employ witchcraft to conjure fog and mire. Watch out for their ambushes when encountering such terrain.

broadcast_13.content: The Iron Duke's troops are leading the Victorian army's effort against the Sarkaz army.

broadcast_14.content: The battlefield is still deteriorating. Make sure your squad is well-equipped with all kinds of supplies.

broadcast_15.content: Some events only occur at certain times. If you miss them, you will not see them for the rest of the run.

broadcast_16.content: Siege has led the Exemplars to victory against the Sarkaz legion at Silverrock Bluffs, using the Sighs of Kings to lower the area's levels of active Originium.

broadcast_17.content: The clouds are gone, and the sky shows itself again. Following the victory at Silverrock Bluffs, the Victorian Army has received a great boost to morale, and the counteroffensive begins.

broadcast_18.content: The team ahead has sent word of a mutual aid group of Infected that has been taking in refugees from the battlefield and is moving towards Londinium.

broadcast_19.content: The Sarkaz legion is currently retreating towards Londinium. A small number decided to desert, but the majority hold onto their formations.

broadcast_20.content: Be wary of large abandoned military equipment on the field. Keep your distance, for unstable energy components can cause an explosion at any moment.

broadcast_21.content: According to the team ahead, the large Catastrophe to the west of Londinium has stopped in its tracks, and the route from Westbound Forest to the city can be reopened.

broadcast_22.content: The Iron Duke has led his forces to withdraw from the Victorian Army camp. Now the identifiers of all troops bearing the Wellington flag have been changed from 'friendly' to 'unknown.'

broadcast_23.content: Our situation will only get worse. Prepare yourselves.

broadcast_24.content: Londinium is right before us. Prepare yourselves.

broadcast_25.content: Lost teams will return to Rhodes Island after a period of rest.

broadcast_26.content: The Sarkaz army is constructing a defense line around Londinium with witchcraft turrets and altars on the city walls. Try to get around them and avoid direct engagement.

broadcast_27.content: The Victorian forces are split along three paths trying to surround Londinium from the west, south, and east, while the Sarkaz army did not venture outside to intercept them.

broadcast_28.content: The battle outside Londinium has ended. We're grateful to every squad for your hard work.

broadcast_29.content: The first-responder team responsible for cleaning the battlefield and preventing active Originium from spreading has set off towards Silverrock Bluffs to treat the wounded.

broadcast_30.content: The situation in the outskirts of Londinium has stabilized. Per our analyses, the next battle will break out near the city.

gameTipsList.tip: Can only obtain trophies from Team Simulation
In Team Simulation, you may skip once during Strategy selection
Only some Operators from an Alliance will appear in the Dispatch Center
The Dispatch Center can be manually refreshed even when frozen
Reward Operators from promotions cannot be refreshed or frozen, and will be cleared when entering the next round
Any resources in the temporary Bench will be destroyed when entering the next round
Some special Alliances can be activated without deploying any Operators
Operators' equipment will return to the Bench when promoted and have to be re-equipped
Two of the same equipment will fuse into an upgraded version
Certain equipment combinations can grant Operators additional Alliance effects
Stacked Alliances persist throughout a single simulation, but their effects only apply while the Alliance is active
Usually an Alliance has to be activated first before you can build stacks
You can check Teammate battlefields during the Rest Phase
You can check your next enemy group during the Rest Phase
Easily retreat Operators by dragging them to the Bench
You cannot make any moves after you are ready, but you can cancel your ready state any time, until all your Teammates are ready
Only Teammates who achieve a perfect clear of their wave of enemies can help out during the Unite Phase
Alliance stacks cannot increase when in Unite Phase
During the final attack phase, two players will share one battlefield and cannot see the other duo
During the final attack phase, all participants deal damage to the enemy leader
A Hidden Core can be unlocked after the final attack phase once certain conditions are fulfilled

trap_edd.trapText: Sensor-based mine deployment device. A challenge for the careful, a nightmare for the careless.
